name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_dmax
statement:
theorem flow_dmax (P : FamilyParams K) :
    P.flow.dmax = P.a * P.M
proof:

  have hba : P.b * P.M ≤ P.a * P.M :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right P.b_lt_a.le P.M_pos.le
  change max (P.a * P.M) (max (P.b * P.M) (P.a * P.M)) = P.a * P.M
  rw [max_eq_right hba, max_self]

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_admissible_iff
statement:
theorem flow_admissible_iff (P : FamilyParams ℝ) (S : Finset Terminal) :
    P.flow.Admissible S ↔ S.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h01 : ¬ P.flow.Admissible {0, 1} := by
    intro h
    rw [FlowInstance.admissible_iff, P.flow_dmax] at h
    have hfirst :
        P.a * P.M + P.b * P.M ≤
          ((P.a - P.b) * P.M - 1) + (2 * P.b - P.a) * P.M +
            P.a * P.M := by
      simpa [flow] using h.1
    nlinarith
  have h02 : ¬ P.flow.Admissible {0, 2} := by
    intro h
    rw [FlowInstance.admissible_iff, P.flow_dmax] at h
    have hmiddle :
        P.a * P.M + P.a * P.M ≤
          ((P.a - P.b) * P.M - 1) + (2 * P.b - P.a) * P.M +
            ((P.a - P.b) * P.M - 1) + P.a * P.M := by
      simpa [flow] using h.2.1
    nlinarith
  have h12 : ¬ P.flow.Admissible {1, 2} := by
    intro h
    rw [FlowInstance.admissible_iff, P.flow_dmax] at h
    have hthird :
        P.b * P.M + P.a * P.M ≤
          (2 * P.b - P.a) * P.M + ((P.a - P.b) * P.M - 1) +
            P.a * P.M := by
      simpa [flow] using h.2.2
    nlinarith
  constructor
  · intro hS
    by_contra hcard
    fin_cases S <;> simp at hcard
    · exact h01 hS
    · exact h02 hS
    · exact h12 hS
    · exact h01 (P.flow.admissible_mono (by decide) hS)
  · intro hcard
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.card_le_one_iff_subset_singleton.mp hcard
    exact P.flow.admissible_mono hi (P.flow.admissible_singleton i)

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_fcost
statement:
theorem flow_fcost (P : FamilyParams K) :
    P.flow.fcost =
      (P.a ^ 2 - P.a * P.b + 2 * P.b ^ 2) * P.M + 2 * P.b
proof:
:= by
  rw [FlowInstance.fcost_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp
  ring

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_ucost
statement:
theorem flow_ucost (P : FamilyParams K) (S : Finset Terminal) :
    P.flow.ucost S =
      (if 0 ∈ S then 0 else P.a * P.b * P.M) +
      (if 1 ∈ S then 0 else P.a * P.b * P.M) +
      (if 2 ∈ S then 0 else P.a * P.b * P.M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FlowInstance.ucost_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_fcost_pos
statement: theorem flow_fcost_pos (P : FamilyParams ℝ) : 0 < P.flow.fcost
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.flow_fcost]
  have ha : 0 < P.a := lt_trans P.b_pos P.b_lt_a
  have hab : 0 < P.a - P.b := sub_pos.mpr P.b_lt_a
  have hcoef : 0 < P.a * (P.a - P.b) + 2 * P.b ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hrewrite :
      P.a ^ 2 - P.a * P.b + 2 * P.b ^ 2 =
        P.a * (P.a - P.b) + 2 * P.b ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [hrewrite]
  exact add_pos (mul_pos hcoef P.M_pos) (mul_pos (by norm_num) P.b_pos)

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_ucost_lower
statement:
theorem flow_ucost_lower (P : FamilyParams ℝ) (S : Finset Terminal)
    (hS : P.flow.Admissible S) :
    2 * P.a * P.b * P.M ≤ P.flow.ucost S
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.flow_admissible_iff] at hS
  rw [P.flow_ucost]
  have hq : 0 ≤ P.a * P.b * P.M :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (lt_trans P.b_pos P.b_lt_a).le P.b_pos.le) P.M_pos.le
  fin_cases S <;> simp at hS ⊢ <;> nlinarith

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_ucost_attained

proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (P.flow.optimalUCost_le P.flow_ucost_attained.1).trans_eq
      P.flow_ucost_attained.2
  · exact P.flow.le_optimalUCost P.flow_ucost_lower

name: Goemans.FamilyParams.flow_ratio

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.sum_arc
statement:
private theorem sum_arc (g : Arc ι m → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, g a) =
      (∑ t, g (.stage t)) +
        ((∑ i, g (.cheapExit i)) + ∑ i, g (.expensiveExit i))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a, g a) =
        ∑ a : Fin m ⊕ (ι ⊕ ι), g ((arcEquiv ι m).symm a) :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (arcEquiv ι m) g
        (fun a => g ((arcEquiv ι m).symm a)) (fun a => by simp)
    _ = (∑ t, g (.stage t)) +
          ((∑ i, g (.cheapExit i)) + ∑ i, g (.expensiveExit i)) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      rfl

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.d_le_dmax
statement: theorem d_le_dmax (i : ι) : I.d i ≤ I.dmax
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup' I.d (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.dmax_pos
statement: theorem dmax_pos : 0 < I.dmax
proof:
:= by

  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (I.d_pos i) (I.d_le_dmax i)

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.false_of_zero_stages

  have h := I.e_lt_p i
  omega

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.arcCost_nonneg

proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | stage _ => simp [arcCost]
  | cheapExit _ => simp [arcCost]
  | expensiveExit i => simpa [arcCost] using I.c_nonneg i

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.routingCost_eq_sum_arc
statement:
theorem routingCost_eq_sum_arc (S : Finset ι) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_arc]
  simp [routingCost, arcCost, load]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.terminal_stage_diff
statement:
private theorem terminal_stage_diff (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) (i : ι) :
    (if i ∈ S then
        (if t.val < (I.p i).val then I.d i else 0)
      else
        (if t.val < (I.e i).val then I.d i else 0)) -
      ((if t.val < (I.p i).val then I.f i else 0) +
        (if t.val < (I.e i).val then I.d i - I.f i else 0)) =
      I.excessTerm S t i
proof:
:= by
  have hep := I.e_lt_p i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;>
    by_cases hte : t.val < (I.e i).val <;>
      by_cases htp : t.val < (I.p i).val
  all_goals simp [excessTerm, ActiveAt, hi, hte, htp]
  all_goals try omega

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageLoad_sub_stageX
statement:
theorem stageLoad_sub_stageX (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageLoad S t - I.stageX t = I.stageExcess S t
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageLoad, stageX, stageExcess, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => I.terminal_stage_diff S t i

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.load_sub_x_stage
statement:
theorem load_sub_x_stage (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) :
    I.load S (.stage t) - I.x (.stage t) = I.stageExcess S t
proof:
:=
  I.stageLoad_sub_stageX S t

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.cheapExit_safe
statement:
theorem cheapExit_safe (S : Finset ι) (i : ι) :
    I.load S (.cheapExit i) ≤ I.x (.cheapExit i) + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  rw [load, x]
  split_ifs
  · linarith [I.f_nonneg i, I.d_le_dmax i]
  · linarith [I.f_nonneg i, I.dmax_pos]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.expensiveExit_safe
statement:
theorem expensiveExit_safe (S : Finset ι) (i : ι) :
    I.load S (.expensiveExit i) ≤ I.x (.expensiveExit i) + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  rw [load, x]
  split_ifs
  · linarith [I.f_le_d i, I.dmax_pos]
  · linarith [I.f_le_d i, I.d_le_dmax i]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissible_iff_stage
statement:
theorem admissible_iff_stage (S : Finset ι) :
    I.Admissible S ↔ ∀ t, I.stageLoad S t ≤ I.stageX t + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t
    exact h (.stage t)
  · intro h a
    cases a with
    | stage t => exact h t
    | cheapExit i => exact I.cheapExit_safe S i
    | expensiveExit i => exact I.expensiveExit_safe S i

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.excessTerm_mono
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : I.ActiveAt i t
  · by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
    · have hiT := hST hiS
      simp [excessTerm, ha, hiS, hiT]
    · by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hiS, hiT, if_true, if_false]
        linarith [I.d_pos i]
      · simp [excessTerm, ha, hiS, hiT]
  · simp [excessTerm, ha]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageExcess_mono
statement:
theorem stageExcess_mono {S T : Finset ι} (hST : S ⊆ T) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageExcess S t ≤ I.stageExcess T t
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact I.excessTerm_mono hST t i

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageExcess_erase_of_not_active
statement:
theorem stageExcess_erase_of_not_active (S : Finset ι) (i : ι) (t : Fin m)
    (hi : ¬ I.ActiveAt i t) :
    I.stageExcess (S.erase i) t = I.stageExcess S t
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageExcess, stageExcess]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  by_cases hli : l = i
  · subst l
    simp [excessTerm, hi]
  · simp [excessTerm, hli]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageLoad_mono
statement:
theorem stageLoad_mono {S T : Finset ι} (hST : S ⊆ T) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageLoad S t ≤ I.stageLoad T t
proof:
:= by
  have hS := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX S t
  have hT := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX T t
  linarith [I.stageExcess_mono hST t]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissible_mono
statement:
theorem admissible_mono {S T : Finset ι} (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (hT : I.Admissible T) : I.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.admissible_iff_stage] at hT ⊢
  intro t
  exact le_trans (I.stageLoad_mono hST t) (hT t)

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageExcess_le_routedDemand
statement:
theorem stageExcess_le_routedDemand (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageExcess S t ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, I.d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageExcess]
  calc
    (∑ i, I.excessTerm S t i) ≤
        ∑ i, if i ∈ S then I.d i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      by_cases ha : I.ActiveAt i t <;> by_cases hi : i ∈ S
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hi, if_true]
        linarith [I.f_nonneg i]
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hi, if_true, if_false]
        linarith [I.f_nonneg i]
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hi, if_false, if_true]
        exact (I.d_pos i).le
      · simp [excessTerm, ha, hi]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ S, I.d i := by simp

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageLoad_le_stageX_add_routedDemand
statement:
theorem stageLoad_le_stageX_add_routedDemand (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageLoad S t ≤ I.stageX t + ∑ i ∈ S, I.d i
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX S t
  linarith [I.stageExcess_le_routedDemand S t]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissible_empty
statement: theorem admissible_empty : I.Admissible ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.admissible_iff_stage]
  intro t
  have h := I.stageLoad_le_stageX_add_routedDemand ∅ t
  simp only [Finset.sum_empty, add_zero] at h
  linarith [I.dmax_pos]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissible_singleton
statement: theorem admissible_singleton (i : ι) : I.Admissible {i}
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.admissible_iff_stage]
  intro t
  have h := I.stageLoad_le_stageX_add_routedDemand {i} t
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  linarith [I.d_le_dmax i]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissible_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem admissible_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] (S : Finset ι) :
    I.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  rcases ‹Nonempty ι› with ⟨i⟩
  apply I.admissible_mono (T := {i}) ?_ (I.admissible_singleton i)
  intro j _
  simp [Subsingleton.elim j i]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageExcess_le_routedRemainder
statement:
theorem stageExcess_le_routedRemainder (S : Finset ι) (t : Fin m) :
    I.stageExcess S t ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, (I.d i - I.f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageExcess]
  calc
    (∑ i, I.excessTerm S t i) ≤
        ∑ i, if i ∈ S then I.d i - I.f i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      by_cases ha : I.ActiveAt i t <;> by_cases hi : i ∈ S
      · simp [excessTerm, ha, hi]
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hi, if_true, if_false]
        exact neg_nonpos.mpr (I.f_nonneg i)
      · simp only [excessTerm, ha, hi, if_false, if_true]
        linarith [I.f_le_d i]
      · simp [excessTerm, ha, hi]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ S, (I.d i - I.f i) := by simp

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.blockedPair_margin_lt
statement:
theorem blockedPair_margin_lt {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hblocked : ¬ I.Admissible {i, j}) :
    I.f i + I.f j < I.d i + I.d j - I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.admissible_iff_stage] at hblocked
  push Not at hblocked
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hblocked
  have hdiff := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX {i, j} t
  have hrem := I.stageExcess_le_routedRemainder {i, j} t
  simp [hij] at hrem
  linarith

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.blockedPair_violation_stage
statement:
theorem blockedPair_violation_stage {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hblocked : ¬ I.Admissible {i, j}) :
    ∃ t, I.stageX t + I.dmax < I.stageLoad {i, j} t ∧
      I.ActiveAt i t ∧ I.ActiveAt j t
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.admissible_iff_stage] at hblocked
  push Not at hblocked
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hblocked
  have hdiff := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX {i, j} t
  have hexcess : I.dmax < I.stageExcess {i, j} t := by
    linarith
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hi
    have herase := I.stageExcess_erase_of_not_active {i, j} i t hi
    have hsingle := I.stageExcess_le_routedDemand {j} t
    simp [hij] at herase
    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at hsingle
    linarith [I.d_le_dmax j]
  · by_contra hj
    have herase := I.stageExcess_erase_of_not_active {i, j} j t hj
    have hsingle := I.stageExcess_le_routedDemand {i} t
    have heraseFinset : ({i, j} : Finset ι).erase j = {i} := by
      calc
        ({i, j} : Finset ι).erase j = ({j, i} : Finset ι).erase j :=
          congrArg (fun S : Finset ι => S.erase j) (Finset.pair_comm i j)
        _ = {i} := Finset.erase_insert (by simpa using hij.symm)
    rw [heraseFinset] at herase
    simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at hsingle
    linarith [I.d_le_dmax i]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.stageExcess_pair_eq_fullSum
statement:
theorem stageExcess_pair_eq_fullSum {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (t : Fin m)
    (hall : ∀ l, I.ActiveAt l t) :
    I.stageExcess {i, j} t =
      I.d i + I.d j - ∑ l, I.f l
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageExcess]
  calc
    (∑ l, I.excessTerm {i, j} t l) =
        ∑ l, (-I.f l + if l ∈ ({i, j} : Finset ι) then I.d l else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      by_cases hl : l ∈ ({i, j} : Finset ι)
      · simp only [excessTerm, hall l, hl, if_true]
        linarith
      · simp [excessTerm, hall l, hl]
    _ = I.d i + I.d j - ∑ l, I.f l := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      have hfilter :
          Finset.univ.filter (fun l => l ∈ ({i, j} : Finset ι)) = {i, j} := by
        ext l
        simp
      rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_pair hij]
      rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      linarith

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.fullAggregation_bounds
statement:
theorem fullAggregation_bounds {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (t : Fin m)
    (hviolate : I.stageX t + I.dmax < I.stageLoad {i, j} t)
    (hall : ∀ l, I.ActiveAt l t) :
    I.stageExcess {i, j} t =
        I.d i + I.d j - ∑ l, I.f l ∧
      (∑ l, I.f l) < I.d i + I.d j - I.dmax ∧
      I.d i + I.d j - I.dmax ≤ min (I.d i) (I.d j) ∧
      min (I.d i) (I.d j) ≤ I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  have hagg := I.stageExcess_pair_eq_fullSum hij t hall
  have hdiff := I.stageLoad_sub_stageX {i, j} t
  refine ⟨hagg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · apply le_min
    · linarith [I.d_le_dmax j]
    · linarith [I.d_le_dmax i]
  · exact (min_le_left (I.d i) (I.d j)).trans (I.d_le_dmax i)

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.helly_full_aggregation
statement:
theorem helly_full_aggregation [Nontrivial ι]
    (hblocked : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ I.Admissible {i, j}) :
    ∃ i j t, i ≠ j ∧
      ¬ I.Admissible {i, j} ∧
      I.stageX t + I.dmax < I.stageLoad {i, j} t ∧
      (∀ l, I.ActiveAt l t) ∧
      I.stageExcess {i, j} t =
          I.d i + I.d j - ∑ l, I.f l ∧
      (∑ l, I.f l) < I.d i + I.d j - I.dmax ∧
      I.d i + I.d j - I.dmax ≤ min (I.d i) (I.d j) ∧
      min (I.d i) (I.d j) ≤ I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun l => (I.e l).val) Finset.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun l => (I.p l).val) Finset.univ_nonempty
  by_cases hqr : q = r
  · subst r
    obtain ⟨j, hjq⟩ := exists_ne q
    have hqj : q ≠ j := Ne.symm hjq
    have hqjBlocked := hblocked q j hqj
    obtain ⟨t, hviolate, hqActive, -⟩ :=
      I.blockedPair_violation_stage hqj hqjBlocked
    have hall : ∀ l, I.ActiveAt l t := by
      intro l
      exact ⟨(hr l (Finset.mem_univ l)).trans hqActive.1,
        hqActive.2.trans_le (hq l (Finset.mem_univ l))⟩
    obtain ⟨hagg, hsum, hmin, hminD⟩ :=
      I.fullAggregation_bounds hqj t hviolate hall
    exact ⟨q, j, t, hqj, hqjBlocked, hviolate, hall,
      hagg, hsum, hmin, hminD⟩
  · have hqrBlocked := hblocked q r hqr
    obtain ⟨t, hviolate, hqActive, hrActive⟩ :=
      I.blockedPair_violation_stage hqr hqrBlocked
    have hall : ∀ l, I.ActiveAt l t := by
      intro l
      exact ⟨(hr l (Finset.mem_univ l)).trans hrActive.1,
        hqActive.2.trans_le (hq l (Finset.mem_univ l))⟩
    obtain ⟨hagg, hsum, hmin, hminD⟩ :=
      I.fullAggregation_bounds hqr t hviolate hall
    exact ⟨q, r, t, hqr, hqrBlocked, hviolate, hall,
      hagg, hsum, hmin, hminD⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.ratio_sum_lt_one_of_sum_lt_both
statement:
private theorem ratio_sum_lt_one_of_sum_lt_both {a b x y : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hxa : x + y < a) (hxb : x + y < b) :
    x / a + y / b < 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · have hmul : y * a ≤ y * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hy
    have hstrict : (x + y) * b < a * b :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hxa hb
    have hnum : x * b + y * a < a * b := by
      nlinarith
    rw [show x / a + y / b = (x * b + y * a) / (a * b) by
      field_simp]
    exact (div_lt_one (mul_pos ha hb)).2 hnum
  · have hmul : x * b ≤ x * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hba hx
    have hstrict : (x + y) * a < b * a :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hxb ha
    have hnum : x * b + y * a < a * b := by
      nlinarith
    rw [show x / a + y / b = (x * b + y * a) / (a * b) by
      field_simp]
    exact (div_lt_one (mul_pos ha hb)).2 hnum

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.blockedPair_cheapFraction_lt_one
statement:
theorem blockedPair_cheapFraction_lt_one {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hblocked : ¬ I.Admissible {i, j}) :
    I.f i / I.d i + I.f j / I.d j < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm := I.blockedPair_margin_lt hij hblocked
  have hiD := I.d_le_dmax i
  have hjD := I.d_le_dmax j
  apply ratio_sum_lt_one_of_sum_lt_both
      (I.d_pos i) (I.d_pos j) (I.f_nonneg i) (I.f_nonneg j)
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: Goemans.pair_bound
statement:
theorem pair_bound {d1 d2 f1 f2 D : ℝ} (hd1 : 0 < d1) (hd2 : 0 < d2)
    (hf1 : 0 ≤ f1) (hf2 : 0 ≤ f2)
    (hD1 : d1 ≤ D) (hD2 : d2 ≤ D)
    (hblock : f1 + f2 ≤ d1 + d2 - D) :
    f1 / d1 + f2 / d2 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hd1) (ne_of_gt hd2), div_le_one (mul_pos hd1 hd2)]
  rcases le_total d1 d2 with h | h
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hf2 (sub_nonneg.2 h), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hD2) hd2.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hblock hd2.le]
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hf1 (sub_nonneg.2 h), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hD1) hd1.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hblock hd1.le]

name: Goemans.pair_bound_lt
statement:
theorem pair_bound_lt {d1 d2 f1 f2 D : ℝ}
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) (hd2 : 0 < d2)
    (hf1 : 0 ≤ f1) (hf2 : 0 ≤ f2)
    (hD1 : d1 ≤ D) (hD2 : d2 ≤ D)
    (hblock : f1 + f2 < d1 + d2 - D) :
    f1 / d1 + f2 / d2 < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hd1) (ne_of_gt hd2),
    div_lt_one (mul_pos hd1 hd2)]
  rcases le_total d1 d2 with h | h
  · have hb := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hblock hd2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hf2 (sub_nonneg.2 h),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hD2) hd2.le]
  · have hb := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hblock hd1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hf1 (sub_nonneg.2 h),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hD1) hd1.le]

name: Goemans.splitLP_shifted
statement:
theorem splitLP_shifted {D δ f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδD : δ ≤ D)
    (hf2δ : f2 ≤ δ)
    (h12 : f1 + f2 ≤ δ) (h23 : f2 + f3 ≤ δ) (h123 : f1 + f2 + f3 ≤ D) :
    f1 / D + f2 / δ + f3 / D ≤ 4 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : f1 / D + f2 / δ + f3 / D = (f1 * δ + f2 * D + f3 * δ) / (D * δ) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexp, div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hD hδ)]
  have hsq : 0 ≤ 2 * δ ^ 2 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * δ * D + D ^ 2 := by
    have hexp2 : (Real.sqrt 2 * δ - D) ^ 2 =
        2 * δ ^ 2 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * δ * D + D ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination (δ ^ 2) * sqrt2_mul_self
    exact hexp2 ▸ sq_nonneg _
  have hs2 := sqrt2_mul_self
  rcases le_total D (2 * δ) with hcase | hcase
  · 
    have t1 : 0 ≤ (2 * δ - D) * (D - f2 - (f1 + f3)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ (D - δ) * (2 * δ - 2 * f2 - (f1 + f3)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    nlinarith [t1, t2, hsq]
  · 
    have h3 : 0 ≤ 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 3), hs2]
    have t1 : 0 ≤ δ * (2 * δ - 2 * f2 - (f1 + f3)) :=
      mul_nonneg hδ.le (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ (δ - f2) * (D - 2 * δ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have t3 : 0 ≤ (3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2) * (D * δ) :=
      mul_nonneg h3 (mul_pos hD hδ).le
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]

name: Goemans.splitLP
statement:
theorem splitLP {d1 d2 d3 f1 f2 f3 D : ℝ}
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) (hd2 : 0 < d2) (hd3 : 0 < d3)
    (hf1d : f1 ≤ d1) (hf2d : f2 ≤ d2) (hf3d : f3 ≤ d3)
    (hD1 : d1 ≤ D) (hD2 : d2 ≤ D) (hD3 : d3 ≤ D)
    (h12 : f1 + f2 ≤ d1 + d2 - D) (h23 : f2 + f3 ≤ d2 + d3 - D)
    (h13 : f1 + f2 + f3 ≤ d1 + d3 - D) :
    f1 / d1 + f2 / d2 + f3 / d3 ≤ 4 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le hd1 hD1
  have key := splitLP_shifted (D := D) (δ := d2)
    (f1 := f1 + (D - d1)) (f2 := f2) (f3 := f3 + (D - d3))
    hD hd2 hD2 hf2d
    (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have mono1 : f1 / d1 ≤ (f1 + (D - d1)) / D := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd1 hD]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hf1d) (sub_nonneg.2 hD1)]
  have mono3 : f3 / d3 ≤ (f3 + (D - d3)) / D := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd3 hD]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hf3d) (sub_nonneg.2 hD3)]
  linarith [key, mono1, mono3]

name: Goemans.splitLP_lt
statement:
theorem splitLP_lt {d1 d2 d3 f1 f2 f3 D : ℝ}
    (hd1 : 0 < d1) (hd2 : 0 < d2) (hd3 : 0 < d3)
    (hf1 : 0 ≤ f1) (hf3 : 0 ≤ f3)
    (hf1d : f1 ≤ d1) (hf2d : f2 ≤ d2) (hf3d : f3 ≤ d3)
    (hD1 : d1 ≤ D) (hD2 : d2 ≤ D) (hD3 : d3 ≤ D)
    (h12 : f1 + f2 < d1 + d2 - D)
    (h23 : f2 + f3 ≤ d2 + d3 - D)
    (h13 : f1 + f2 + f3 < d1 + d3 - D) :
    f1 / d1 + f2 / d2 + f3 / d3 < 4 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le hd1 hD1
  let g1 := f1 + (D - d1)
  let g3 := f3 + (D - d3)
  let ε := min (d2 - (g1 + f2)) (D - (g1 + f2 + g3)) / 2
  have hs12 : 0 < d2 - (g1 + f2) := by
    dsimp [g1]
    linarith
  have hs13 : 0 < D - (g1 + f2 + g3) := by
    dsimp [g1, g3]
    linarith
  have hε : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    positivity
  have hε12 : ε ≤ d2 - (g1 + f2) := by
    dsimp [ε]
    have hmin := min_le_left (d2 - (g1 + f2)) (D - (g1 + f2 + g3))
    have hmin0 : 0 ≤ min (d2 - (g1 + f2)) (D - (g1 + f2 + g3)) :=
      le_of_lt (lt_min hs12 hs13)
    linarith
  have hε13 : ε ≤ D - (g1 + f2 + g3) := by
    dsimp [ε]
    have hmin := min_le_right (d2 - (g1 + f2)) (D - (g1 + f2 + g3))
    have hmin0 : 0 ≤ min (d2 - (g1 + f2)) (D - (g1 + f2 + g3)) :=
      le_of_lt (lt_min hs12 hs13)
    linarith
  have hg10 : 0 ≤ g1 := by
    dsimp [g1]
    linarith
  have hg30 : 0 ≤ g3 := by
    dsimp [g3]
    linarith
  have key := splitLP_shifted (D := D) (δ := d2)
    (f1 := g1 + ε) (f2 := f2) (f3 := g3)
    hD hd2 hD2 hf2d
    (by linarith) (by
      dsimp [g3]
      linarith) (by linarith)
  have mono1 : f1 / d1 ≤ g1 / D := by
    dsimp [g1]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd1 hD]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hf1d) (sub_nonneg.2 hD1)]
  have mono3 : f3 / d3 ≤ g3 / D := by
    dsimp [g3]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd3 hD]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hf3d) (sub_nonneg.2 hD3)]
  have hinc : g1 / D < (g1 + ε) / D :=
    (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hD).2 (by linarith)
  linarith

name: Goemans.weight_core_a
statement:
theorem weight_core_a {r a1 a2 a3 m1 m2 m3 : ℝ}
    (hm2 : 0 ≤ m2) (hm12 : m2 ≤ m1) (hm13 : m1 ≤ m3)
    (ha3 : 0 ≤ a3) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h13 : 1 ≤ r * (a1 + a3)) (hsum : 2 ≤ r * (a1 + a2 + a3)) :
    m1 + m2 ≤ r * (m1 * a1 + m2 * a2 + m3 * a3)
proof:
:= by
  have t1 : 0 ≤ (m1 - m2) * (r * (a1 + a3) - 1) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have t2 : 0 ≤ m2 * (r * (a1 + a2 + a3) - 2) := mul_nonneg hm2 (by linarith)
  have t3 : 0 ≤ r * a3 * (m3 - m1) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha3) (by linarith)
  nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]

name: Goemans.weight_core_a_lt
statement:
theorem weight_core_a_lt {r a1 a2 a3 m1 m2 m3 : ℝ}
    (hm2 : 0 ≤ m2) (hm12 : m2 ≤ m1) (hm13 : m1 ≤ m3)
    (ha3 : 0 ≤ a3) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h13 : 1 < r * (a1 + a3)) (hsum : 2 < r * (a1 + a2 + a3))
    (hW : 0 < m1 * a1 + m2 * a2 + m3 * a3) :
    m1 + m2 < r * (m1 * a1 + m2 * a2 + m3 * a3)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm20 : m2 = 0
  · by_cases hm10 : m1 = 0
    · simp only [hm20, hm10, zero_mul, zero_add] at hW ⊢
      have hrpos : 0 < r := by
        rcases hr.eq_or_lt with rfl | hrpos
        · norm_num at h13
        · exact hrpos
      exact mul_pos hrpos hW
    · have hm10le : 0 ≤ m1 := le_trans hm2 hm12
      have hm1pos : 0 < m1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm10le (Ne.symm hm10)
      have t1 : 0 < (m1 - m2) * (r * (a1 + a3) - 1) :=
        mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have t2 : 0 ≤ m2 * (r * (a1 + a2 + a3) - 2) :=
        mul_nonneg hm2 (by linarith)
      have t3 : 0 ≤ r * a3 * (m3 - m1) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha3) (by linarith)
      nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]
  · have hm2pos : 0 < m2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm2 (Ne.symm hm20)
    have t1 : 0 ≤ (m1 - m2) * (r * (a1 + a3) - 1) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 < m2 * (r * (a1 + a2 + a3) - 2) :=
      mul_pos hm2pos (by linarith)
    have t3 : 0 ≤ r * a3 * (m3 - m1) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha3) (by linarith)
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]

name: Goemans.weight_core_b
statement:
theorem weight_core_b {r ai aj ak mi mj mk : ℝ}
    (hmi : 0 ≤ mi) (hmj : 0 ≤ mj) (hmk : 0 ≤ mk)
    (hai : 0 ≤ ai) (haj : 0 ≤ aj) (hak : 0 ≤ ak) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hik : 1 ≤ r * (ai + ak)) (hjk : 1 ≤ r * (aj + ak)) :
    min (mi + mj) mk ≤ r * (mi * ai + mj * aj + mk * ak)
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := le_trans zero_le_one hr
  rcases le_total mk mi with h | h
  · 
    refine le_trans (min_le_right _ _) ?_
    have t1 : 0 ≤ r * ai * (mi - mk) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 hai) (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ mk * (r * (ai + ak) - 1) := mul_nonneg hmk (by linarith)
    have t3 : 0 ≤ r * (mj * aj) := mul_nonneg hr0 (mul_nonneg hmj haj)
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]
  · rcases le_total (mi + mj) mk with h2 | h2
    · 
      refine le_trans (min_le_left _ _) ?_
      have t1 : 0 ≤ r * ak * (mk - mi - mj) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 hak) (by linarith)
      have t2 : 0 ≤ mi * (r * (ai + ak) - 1) := mul_nonneg hmi (by linarith)
      have t3 : 0 ≤ mj * (r * (aj + ak) - 1) := mul_nonneg hmj (by linarith)
      nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]
    · 
      
      refine le_trans (min_le_right _ _) ?_
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ mi + mj) with h0 | h0
      · 
        have hmi0 : mi = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) hmi
        have hmj0 : mj = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) hmj
        have hmk0 : mk = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) hmk
        simp [hmi0, hmj0, hmk0]
      · have t1 : 0 ≤ r * (mi * ai) * (mi + mj - mk) :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 (mul_nonneg hmi hai)) (by linarith)
        have t2 : 0 ≤ r * (mj * aj) * (mi + mj - mk) :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 (mul_nonneg hmj haj)) (by linarith)
        have t3 : 0 ≤ (r * (ai + ak) - 1) * (mi * mk) :=
          mul_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hmi hmk)
        have t4 : 0 ≤ (r * (aj + ak) - 1) * (mj * mk) :=
          mul_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hmj hmk)
        have scaled : (mi + mj) * mk ≤
            (mi + mj) * (r * (mi * ai + mj * aj + mk * ak)) := by
          nlinarith [t1, t2, t3, t4]
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left scaled h0

name: Goemans.weight_core_c
statement:
theorem weight_core_c {r ai aj ak mi mj mk : ℝ}
    (hmi : 0 ≤ mi) (hmj : 0 ≤ mj) (hmk : 0 ≤ mk)
    (hai : 0 ≤ ai) (haj : 0 ≤ aj) (hak : 0 ≤ ak) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hik : 1 ≤ r * (ai + ak)) :
    min mi mk ≤ r * (mi * ai + mj * aj + mk * ak)
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := le_trans zero_le_one hr
  have t3 : 0 ≤ r * (mj * aj) := mul_nonneg hr0 (mul_nonneg hmj haj)
  rcases le_total mi mk with h | h
  · refine le_trans (min_le_left _ _) ?_
    have t1 : 0 ≤ mi * (r * (ai + ak) - 1) := mul_nonneg hmi (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ r * ak * (mk - mi) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 hak) (by linarith)
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]
  · refine le_trans (min_le_right _ _) ?_
    have t1 : 0 ≤ mk * (r * (ai + ak) - 1) := mul_nonneg hmk (by linarith)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ r * ai * (mi - mk) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 hai) (by linarith)
    nlinarith [t1, t2, t3]

name: Goemans.weight_core_d
statement:
theorem weight_core_d {r a1 a2 a3 m1 m2 m3 : ℝ}
    (hm1 : 0 ≤ m1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ m2) (hm3 : 0 ≤ m3)
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (ha3 : 0 ≤ a3) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsum : 1 ≤ r * (a1 + a2 + a3)) :
    min m1 (min m2 m3) ≤ r * (m1 * a1 + m2 * a2 + m3 * a3)
proof:
:= by
  set μ := min m1 (min m2 m3) with hμ
  have hμ1 : μ ≤ m1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hμ2 : μ ≤ m2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hμ3 : μ ≤ m3 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := le_min hm1 (le_min hm2 hm3)
  have t1 : 0 ≤ r * a1 * (m1 - μ) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha1) (by linarith)
  have t2 : 0 ≤ r * a2 * (m2 - μ) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha2) (by linarith)
  have t3 : 0 ≤ r * a3 * (m3 - μ) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr ha3) (by linarith)
  have t4 : 0 ≤ μ * (r * (a1 + a2 + a3) - 1) := mul_nonneg hμ0 (by linarith)
  nlinarith [t1, t2, t3, t4]

name: Goemans.Arc.sum_univ
statement:
theorem Arc.sum_univ {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : Arc → M) :
    ∑ a, f a = f st1 + f st2 + f su + f ut3 + f uv + f vt1 + f vw + f wt2 + f wt3
proof:
:= by
  change f st1 + (f st2 + (f su + (f ut3 + (f uv + (f vt1 + (f vw + (f wt2 + (f wt3 + 0)))))))) = _
  simp [add_assoc]

name: Goemans.decomp0
statement:
private theorem decomp0 {g : Arc → K} {de : K} (h : IsCommodityFlow g 0 de) :
    0 ≤ g vt1 ∧ g vt1 ≤ de ∧
      ∀ a, g a =
        (if onZ 0 a then g vt1 else 0) +
          (if onE 0 a then de - g vt1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := h.conserve .u (by decide) (by decide)
  have hv := h.conserve .v (by decide) (by decide)
  have hw := h.conserve .w (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht2 := h.conserve .t2 (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht3 := h.conserve .t3 (by decide) (by decide)
  have hd := h.demand
  simp only [terminalVertex_zero, inflow_u, outflow_u, inflow_v, outflow_v,
    inflow_w, outflow_w, inflow_t1, outflow_t1, inflow_t2, outflow_t2,
    inflow_t3, outflow_t3, sub_zero] at hu hv hw ht2 ht3 hd
  have hst2 : g st2 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st2, h.nonneg wt2]
  have hwt2 : g wt2 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st2, h.nonneg wt2]
  have hut3 : g ut3 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg ut3, h.nonneg wt3]
  have hwt3 : g wt3 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg ut3, h.nonneg wt3]
  refine ⟨h.nonneg vt1, by linarith [h.nonneg st1], fun a => ?_⟩
  cases a <;> simp [onZ, onE] <;> linarith

name: Goemans.decomp1
statement:
private theorem decomp1 {g : Arc → K} {de : K} (h : IsCommodityFlow g 1 de) :
    0 ≤ g wt2 ∧ g wt2 ≤ de ∧
      ∀ a, g a =
        (if onZ 1 a then g wt2 else 0) +
          (if onE 1 a then de - g wt2 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := h.conserve .u (by decide) (by decide)
  have hv := h.conserve .v (by decide) (by decide)
  have hw := h.conserve .w (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht1 := h.conserve .t1 (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht3 := h.conserve .t3 (by decide) (by decide)
  have hd := h.demand
  simp only [terminalVertex_one, inflow_u, outflow_u, inflow_v, outflow_v,
    inflow_w, outflow_w, inflow_t1, outflow_t1, inflow_t2, outflow_t2,
    inflow_t3, outflow_t3, sub_zero] at hu hv hw ht1 ht3 hd
  have hst1 : g st1 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st1, h.nonneg vt1]
  have hvt1 : g vt1 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st1, h.nonneg vt1]
  have hut3 : g ut3 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg ut3, h.nonneg wt3]
  have hwt3 : g wt3 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg ut3, h.nonneg wt3]
  refine ⟨h.nonneg wt2, by linarith [h.nonneg st2], fun a => ?_⟩
  cases a <;> simp [onZ, onE] <;> linarith

name: Goemans.decomp2
statement:
private theorem decomp2 {g : Arc → K} {de : K} (h : IsCommodityFlow g 2 de) :
    0 ≤ g wt3 ∧ g wt3 ≤ de ∧
      ∀ a, g a =
        (if onZ 2 a then g wt3 else 0) +
          (if onE 2 a then de - g wt3 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := h.conserve .u (by decide) (by decide)
  have hv := h.conserve .v (by decide) (by decide)
  have hw := h.conserve .w (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht1 := h.conserve .t1 (by decide) (by decide)
  have ht2 := h.conserve .t2 (by decide) (by decide)
  have hd := h.demand
  simp only [terminalVertex_two, inflow_u, outflow_u, inflow_v, outflow_v,
    inflow_w, outflow_w, inflow_t1, outflow_t1, inflow_t2, outflow_t2,
    inflow_t3, outflow_t3, sub_zero] at hu hv hw ht1 ht2 hd
  have hst1 : g st1 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st1, h.nonneg vt1]
  have hvt1 : g vt1 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st1, h.nonneg vt1]
  have hst2 : g st2 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st2, h.nonneg wt2]
  have hwt2 : g wt2 = 0 := by linarith [h.nonneg st2, h.nonneg wt2]
  refine ⟨h.nonneg wt3, by linarith [h.nonneg ut3], fun a => ?_⟩
  cases a <;> simp [onZ, onE] <;> linarith

name: Goemans.IsCommodityFlow.commoditySplit_spec
statement:
theorem IsCommodityFlow.commoditySplit_spec {g : Arc → K} {i : Terminal}
    {de : K} (h : IsCommodityFlow g i de) :
    0 ≤ commoditySplit g i ∧ commoditySplit g i ≤ de ∧
      ∀ a, g a =
        (if onZ i a then commoditySplit g i else 0) +
          (if onE i a then de - commoditySplit g i else 0)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [commoditySplit] using decomp0 h
  · simpa [commoditySplit] using decomp1 h
  · simpa [commoditySplit] using decomp2 h

name: Goemans.IsCommodityFlow.exists_split
statement:
theorem IsCommodityFlow.exists_split {g : Arc → K} {i : Terminal} {de : K}
    (h : IsCommodityFlow g i de) :
    ∃ φ, 0 ≤ φ ∧ φ ≤ de ∧
      ∀ a, g a = (if onZ i a then φ else 0) + (if onE i a then de - φ else 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨commoditySplit g i, h.commoditySplit_spec⟩

name: Goemans.isCommodityFlow_split
statement:
theorem isCommodityFlow_split (i : Terminal) {φ de : K} (h0 : 0 ≤ φ)
    (hd : φ ≤ de) :
    IsCommodityFlow
      (fun a => (if onZ i a then φ else 0) + (if onE i a then de - φ else 0))
      i de
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    exact
      { nonneg := fun a => by cases a <;> simp [onZ, onE] <;> linarith
        conserve := fun p hs ht => by
          cases p <;> simp_all <;> simp [onZ, onE]
        demand := by simp [onZ, onE] }

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.exists_optimalRouting
statement:
theorem exists_optimalRouting (I : FlowInstance ℝ) :
    ∃ S : Finset Terminal, I.Admissible S ∧ I.ucost S = I.optimalUCost
proof:
:= by
  have hmem :
      I.optimalUCost ∈ I.admissibleCosts :=
    Finset.min'_mem _ I.admissibleCosts_nonempty
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmem with ⟨S, hS, hcost⟩
  exact ⟨S, I.mem_admissibleRoutings S |>.1 hS, hcost⟩

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.optimalUCost_le
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.min'_le
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨S, I.mem_admissibleRoutings S |>.2 hS, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.le_optimalUCost
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcost⟩ := I.exists_optimalRouting
  rw [← hcost]
  exact h S hS

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.optimalUCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem optimalUCost_nonneg (I : FlowInstance ℝ) :
    0 ≤ I.optimalUCost
proof:
:=
  I.le_optimalUCost fun S _ => I.ucost_nonneg S

name: Goemans.walk_s_terminal_iff
statement:
theorem walk_s_terminal_iff (i : Terminal) (l : List Arc) :
    IsWalkFrom .s (terminalVertex i) l = true ↔ l = Epath i ∨ l = Zpath i
proof:

name: Goemans.WeightedSelection.exists_top_set
statement:
private theorem exists_top_set (c : ι → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hrpos : 0 < r) (hrcard : r < Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι, ∃ i₀ : ι,
      S.card = r ∧
      i₀ ∈ S ∧
      (∀ i ∈ S, c i₀ ≤ c i) ∧
      (∀ j ∉ S, c j ≤ c i₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let candidates : Finset (Finset ι) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset ι => S.card = r
  have hcandidates : candidates.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨S, -, hScard⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι))
        (Nat.le_of_lt hrcard)
    exact ⟨S, by simp [candidates, hScard]⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_max_image candidates (fun T => T.sum c) hcandidates
  have hScard : S.card = r := by
    simpa [candidates] using hS
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (hScard ▸ hrpos)
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image S c hSnonempty
  refine ⟨S, i₀, hScard, hi₀, hmin, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hjErase : j ∉ S.erase i₀ := fun h => hj (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
  have hswapCard : (insert j (S.erase i₀)).card = r := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hjErase, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi₀,
      hScard]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel hrpos
  have hswapMem : insert j (S.erase i₀) ∈ candidates := by
    simp [candidates, hswapCard]
  have hswap :=
    hmax (insert j (S.erase i₀)) hswapMem
  have hsumErase :
      (S.erase i₀).sum c + c i₀ = S.sum c := by
    exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hi₀
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hjErase] at hswap
  linarith

name: Goemans.WeightedSelection.sum_split
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) (p := fun i => i ∈ S) (f := g)]
  simp only [Finset.subset_univ, Finset.filter_mem_eq_of_subset, add_right_inj]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp

statement:
private theorem card_cast_sum_one {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) :

proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Goemans.WeightedSelection.exists_weighted_selection
statement:
theorem exists_weighted_selection (c f : ι → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hf0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hf1 : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1)
    (hsum : (∑ i, f i) ≤ (r : ℝ)) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι,
      S.card ≤ r ∧
      (∑ i, c i * f i) ≤ S.sum c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hrlarge : Fintype.card ι ≤ r
  · refine ⟨Finset.univ, by simpa, ?_⟩
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      mul_le_of_le_one_right (hc i) (hf1 i)
  by_cases hrzero : r = 0
  · subst r
    have hfsumZero : (∑ i, f i) = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (by simpa using hsum) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hf0 i)
    have hfzero : ∀ i, f i = 0 := by
      intro i
      apply le_antisymm
      · have hle : f i ≤ ∑ j, f j :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hf0 j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
        linarith
      · exact hf0 i
    refine ⟨∅, by simp, ?_⟩
    simp [hfzero]
  have hrpos : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hrzero
  have hrcard : r < Fintype.card ι :=
    Nat.lt_of_not_ge hrlarge
  obtain ⟨S, i₀, hScard, hi₀, hinside, houtside⟩ :=
    exists_top_set c r hrpos hrcard
  let a := c i₀
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := hc i₀
  have hout :
      Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * f i) ≤
        a * Sᶜ.sum f := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (houtside i (by simpa using hi)) (hf0 i)
  have hin :
      a * S.sum (fun i => 1 - f i) ≤
        S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hinside i hi) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hf1 i))
  have hmass :
      Sᶜ.sum f ≤ S.sum (fun i => 1 - f i) := by
    have hsplit := sum_split S f
    have hones := card_cast_sum_one S
    rw [hScard] at hones
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linarith
  have houtLeDeficit :
      Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * f i) ≤
        S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) :=
    hout.trans <| (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass ha).trans hin
  refine ⟨S, hScard.le, ?_⟩
  rw [sum_split S (fun i => c i * f i)]
  have hcombine :
      S.sum (fun i => c i * f i) +
          S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) =
        S.sum c := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  linarith [houtLeDeficit, hcombine]

name: Goemans.WeightedSelection.exists_strict_weighted_selection
statement:
theorem exists_strict_weighted_selection (c f : ι → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hf0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hf1 : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1)
    (hsum : (∑ i, f i) < (r : ℝ))
    (hresidual : 0 < ∑ i, c i * (1 - f i)) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι,
      S.card ≤ r ∧
      (∑ i, c i * f i) < S.sum c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hrlarge : Fintype.card ι ≤ r
  · refine ⟨Finset.univ, by simpa, ?_⟩
    have hidentity :
        (∑ i, c i) =
          (∑ i, c i * f i) + ∑ i, c i * (1 - f i) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have hstrict : (∑ i, c i * f i) < ∑ i, c i := by
      linarith [hidentity, hresidual]
    exact hstrict
  have hfsumNonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, f i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hf0 i
  have hrRealPos : (0 : ℝ) < r := hfsumNonneg.trans_lt hsum
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    by_contra hr
    simp only [Nat.not_lt, Nat.le_zero] at hr
    subst r
    norm_num at hrRealPos
  have hrcard : r < Fintype.card ι :=
    Nat.lt_of_not_ge hrlarge
  obtain ⟨S, i₀, hScard, hi₀, hinside, houtside⟩ :=
    exists_top_set c r hrpos hrcard
  let a := c i₀
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := hc i₀
  have hout :
      Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * f i) ≤
        a * Sᶜ.sum f := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (houtside i (by simpa using hi)) (hf0 i)
  have hin :
      a * S.sum (fun i => 1 - f i) ≤
        S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hinside i hi) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hf1 i))
  have hmass :
      Sᶜ.sum f < S.sum (fun i => 1 - f i) := by
    have hsplit := sum_split S f
    have hones := card_cast_sum_one S
    rw [hScard] at hones
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linarith
  have hcombine :
      S.sum (fun i => c i * f i) +
          S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) =
        S.sum c := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  refine ⟨S, hScard.le, ?_⟩
  rw [sum_split S (fun i => c i * f i)]
  by_cases haZero : a = 0
  · have houtZero : Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * f i) = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa [haZero] using hout
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hc i) (hf0 i)
    have houtResidualZero :
        Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      have hciUpper : c i ≤ 0 :=
        haZero ▸ houtside i (by simpa using hi)
      have hci : c i = 0 := le_antisymm hciUpper (hc i)
      simp [hci]
    have hresidualSplit :=
      sum_split S (fun i => c i * (1 - f i))
    rw [houtResidualZero, add_zero] at hresidualSplit
    linarith
  · have haPos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm haZero)
    have hstrict :
        Sᶜ.sum (fun i => c i * f i) <
          S.sum (fun i => c i * (1 - f i)) :=
      hout.trans_lt <| (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hmass haPos).trans_le hin
    linarith

name: Goemans.WeightedSelection.exists_strict_residual_selection
statement:
theorem exists_strict_residual_selection (c f : ι → ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hf0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hf1 : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1)
    (hsum : (∑ i, f i) < (r : ℝ))
    (hresidual : 0 < ∑ i, c i * (1 - f i)) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι,
      S.card ≤ r ∧
      Sᶜ.sum c < ∑ i, c i * (1 - f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hScard, hstrict⟩ :=
    exists_strict_weighted_selection c f r hc hf0 hf1 hsum hresidual
  refine ⟨S, hScard, ?_⟩
  have htotalSplit := sum_split S c
  have hidentity :
      (∑ i, c i) =
        (∑ i, c i * f i) + ∑ i, c i * (1 - f i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  linarith [htotalSplit, hidentity, hstrict]

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.WZ_nonneg

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.sav_lower

  rw [sav]

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.ucost_eq
statement:
theorem ucost_eq (S : Finset Terminal) :
    I.ucost S = ∑ i, I.d i * (if i ∈ S then I.WZ i else I.WE i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ucost]
  simp_rw [load, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · simp only [hi, ite_true, WZ, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
  · simp only [hi, ite_false, WE, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.fcost_eq
statement:
theorem fcost_eq :
    I.fcost = ∑ i, (I.f i * I.WZ i + (I.d i - I.f i) * I.WE i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fcost]
  simp_rw [x, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [WZ, WE, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.ucost_eq_base
statement:
theorem ucost_eq_base (S : Finset Terminal) :
    I.ucost S = I.base + ∑ i, (if i ∈ S then 0 else I.sav i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ucost_eq, base, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [sav]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.fcost_eq_base
statement:
theorem fcost_eq_base :
    I.fcost = I.base + ∑ i, (I.d i - I.f i) * (I.WE i - I.WZ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fcost_eq, base, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.routingCost_eq_sum_compl_of_unit
statement:
theorem routingCost_eq_sum_compl_of_unit
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1) (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    I.routingCost S = ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, I.c i
proof:
:= by

      Sᶜ = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∉ S) := by
    ext i

  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> simp [hi]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.sum_f_lt_laneCount
statement:
theorem sum_f_lt_laneCount
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1) :
    (∑ i, I.f i) < (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hxsum :
      (∑ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l) = ∑ i, I.f i := by
    calc
      (∑ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l) =
          ∑ i, ((if (0 : Fin 1).val < (I.p i).val then I.f i else 0) +
            (if (0 : Fin 1).val < (I.e i).val then
              I.d i - I.f i else 0)) :=
        I.laneX_sum (0 : Fin 1)
      _ = ∑ i, I.f i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [hp i, he i]
        norm_num
  let l₀ : Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)) :=
    ⟨0, I.lane_nonempty (0 : Fin 1)⟩
  have hlt :
      (∑ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l) <
        ∑ _l : Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)), (1 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
    · intro l _
      exact (hxlt l).le
    · exact ⟨l₀, Finset.mem_univ l₀, hxlt l₀⟩
  rw [hxsum] at hlt
  simpa using hlt

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.feasibleCosts_nonempty_of_unit_oneStage
statement:
theorem feasibleCosts_nonempty_of_unit_oneStage
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1) :
    I.feasibleCosts.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ :=
    (I.exists_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_le
      hd he hp hxlt ∅).2 (by simp)
  exact ⟨I.routingCost ∅, ∅, R, hR, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.exists_optimalRouting_of_unit_oneStage
statement:
theorem exists_optimalRouting_of_unit_oneStage
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing),
      I.Admissible S R ∧ I.routingCost S = I.optimalRoutingCost
proof:
:=
  I.exists_optimalRouting
    (I.feasibleCosts_nonempty_of_unit_oneStage hd he hp hxlt)

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.exists_admissibleRouting_cost_lt_fractionalCost
statement:
theorem exists_admissibleRouting_cost_lt_fractionalCost
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1)
    (hcost : 0 < I.fractionalCost) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing),
      I.Admissible S R ∧ I.routingCost S < I.fractionalCost
proof:
:= by
  have hf1 : ∀ i, I.f i ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    simpa [hd i] using I.f_le_d i
  have hsum := I.sum_f_lt_laneCount he hp hxlt
  have hresidual :
      0 < ∑ i, I.c i * (1 - I.f i) := by
    simpa only [I.fractionalCost_eq_residual_of_unit hd] using hcost
  obtain ⟨S, hScard, hSstrict⟩ :=
    WeightedSelection.exists_strict_residual_selection
      I.c I.f (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1))
      I.c_nonneg I.f_nonneg hf1 hsum hresidual
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ :=
    (I.exists_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_le
      hd he hp hxlt S).2 hScard
  refine ⟨S, R, hR, ?_⟩
  rw [I.routingCost_eq_sum_compl_of_unit hd S,
    I.fractionalCost_eq_residual_of_unit hd]
  exact hSstrict

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ratio_lt_one_of_unit_oneStage
statement:
theorem ratio_lt_one_of_unit_oneStage
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1)
    (hcost : 0 < I.fractionalCost) :
    I.ratio < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, R, hR, hstrict⟩ :=
    I.exists_admissibleRouting_cost_lt_fractionalCost
      hd he hp hxlt hcost
  have hopt : I.optimalRoutingCost < I.fractionalCost :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (I.optimalRoutingCost_le hR) hstrict
  exact (div_lt_one hcost).2 hopt

          ((n : ℝ) + 1)) /
        (((((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) ^ 2 -
              ((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) * ((extremalRats n).num : ℝ) +
              2 * ((extremalRats n).num : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) +

proof:
:= by
  rw [integralFamilyInstance, PositiveCostInstance.ratio]
  change
    (integralFamilyParams n).flow.toReal.optimalUCost /
        (integralFamilyParams n).flow.toReal.fcost = _

name: Goemans.integralFamily_ratio_normalized
statement:
theorem integralFamily_ratio_normalized (n : ℕ) :
    (integralFamilyInstance n).ratio =
      (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
        (1 - (extremalRats n : ℝ) + 2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
            (((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralFamily_ratio_formula, Rat.cast_def]
  have hd : ((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (extremalRats n).den_ne_zero
  have hM : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Goemans.tendsto_integralCorrection
statement:
private theorem tendsto_integralCorrection :
    Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
          (((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero (g := fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
  · intro n
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (by
        nlinarith [(extremalRats_bounds n).1]))
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity))
  · intro n
    have hδle : (extremalRats n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      have hinv_lt_one : 1 / Real.sqrt 2 < (1 : ℝ) := by
        simpa using (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
          one_lt_sqrt2)
      exact (extremalRats_bounds n).2.le.trans hinv_lt_one.le
    have ha1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (extremalRats n).den := by
      exact_mod_cast (extremalRats n).den_pos
    have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    apply div_le_div₀ (by norm_num) (by nlinarith) hMpos
    simpa using (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 hMpos.le)
  · have hM : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 1) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hM
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 2) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    convert htwo.mul hinv using 1 <;> norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Goemans.tendsto_integralFamily_ratio
statement:
theorem tendsto_integralFamily_ratio :
    Tendsto (fun n => (integralFamilyInstance n).ratio) atTop (𝓝 rhoStar)
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  have hδ : Tendsto (fun n => (extremalRats n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 δ) :=
    tendsto_extremalRats
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := div_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num))
  have hδlt : δ < 1 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    simpa using (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      one_lt_sqrt2)
  have hdenpos : 0 < 1 - δ + 2 * δ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hnum :
      Tendsto (fun n => 2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (2 * δ)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul hδ
  have hden :
      Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          1 - (extremalRats n : ℝ) + 2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ) ^ 2 +
            (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
              (((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
        atTop (𝓝 (1 - δ + 2 * δ ^ 2)) := by
    simpa using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub hδ).add
        (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hδ.pow 2))).add tendsto_integralCorrection
  have hratio :
      Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
            (1 - (extremalRats n : ℝ) + 2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ) ^ 2 +
              (2 * (extremalRats n : ℝ)) /
                (((extremalRats n).den : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1))))
        atTop (𝓝 ((2 * δ) / (1 - δ + 2 * δ ^ 2))) :=
    hnum.div hden hdenpos.ne'
  have hlimit : (2 * δ) / (1 - δ + 2 * δ ^ 2) = rhoStar := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [rhoStar]
    have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)).ne'
    have hr : 2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := rhoStar_denom_pos.ne'
    have hd :
        1 - 1 / Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      positivity
    apply (div_eq_iff hd).2
    field_simp [hs, hr]
    nlinarith [sqrt2_mul_self]
  rw [hlimit] at hratio
  apply hratio.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with n
  exact (integralFamily_ratio_normalized n).symm

name: Goemans.extremal_limit_identity

proof:

  have h₁ : 4 - Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by
    nlinarith [sqrt2_lt_bound]
  have h₂ : 2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt rhoStar_denom_pos
  field_simp [h₁, h₂]

name: Goemans.tendsto_extremalFamily_ratio
statement:
theorem tendsto_extremalFamily_ratio :
    Tendsto (fun n => (extremalFamilyInstance n).ratio) atTop (𝓝 rhoStar)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 3) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 3 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 3)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hM
  have hden : 4 - Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by
    nlinarith [sqrt2_lt_bound]
  have hnum :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (2 * Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ)) atTop
        (𝓝 (2 * Real.sqrt 2)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have hc :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (4 - Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ)) atTop
        (𝓝 (4 - Real.sqrt 2)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have htwo : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 2) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have hdenlim :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => (4 - Real.sqrt 2) + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 3)⁻¹)
        atTop (𝓝 (4 - Real.sqrt 2)) := by
    simpa using hc.add (htwo.mul hinv)
  have hcore :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (2 * Real.sqrt 2) /
            ((4 - Real.sqrt 2) + 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 3)⁻¹))
        atTop (𝓝 ((2 * Real.sqrt 2) / (4 - Real.sqrt 2))) :=
    hnum.div hdenlim hden
  rw [extremal_limit_identity] at hcore
  apply hcore.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with n
  rw [extremalFamily_ratio_eq]
  have hMn : (n : ℝ) + 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Goemans.GraphInstance.exists_optimalRouting
statement:
theorem exists_optimalRouting (J : GraphInstance ℝ) :
    ∃ r : Routing, J.Admissible r.1 ∧ J.ucost r.1 = J.optimalUCost
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : J.optimalUCost ∈ J.admissibleCosts :=
    Finset.min'_mem _ J.admissibleCosts_nonempty
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmem with ⟨r, hr, hcost⟩
  exact ⟨r, (J.mem_admissibleRoutings r).1 hr, hcost⟩

name: Goemans.GraphInstance.optimalUCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem optimalUCost_nonneg (J : GraphInstance ℝ) :
    0 ≤ J.optimalUCost
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, _, hcost⟩ := J.exists_optimalRouting
  rw [← hcost]
  exact J.ucost_nonneg r.1

name: Goemans.GraphInstance.optimalUCost_le
statement:
theorem optimalUCost_le (J : GraphInstance ℝ) {r : Routing}
    (hr : J.Admissible r.1) : J.optimalUCost ≤ J.ucost r.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.min'_le
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r, (J.mem_admissibleRoutings r).2 hr, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.GraphInstance.optimalUCost_eq
statement:
theorem optimalUCost_eq (J : GraphInstance ℝ) (I : FlowInstance ℝ)
    (hd : J.d = I.d) (hc : J.c = I.c) (hx : ∀ a, J.x a = I.x a) :
    J.optimalUCost = I.optimalUCost
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hcost⟩ := I.exists_optimalRouting
    have h1 : J.optimalUCost ≤ J.ucost (pathOf S) :=
      J.optimalUCost_le (r := ⟨pathOf S, isRouting_pathOf S⟩)
        ((J.admissible_pathOf I hd hx S).2 hS)
    rw [J.ucost_pathOf I hd hc S, hcost] at h1
    exact h1
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hcost⟩ := J.exists_optimalRouting
    have h1 : I.optimalUCost ≤ I.ucost (routingSet r.1) :=
      I.optimalUCost_le ((J.admissible_iff_flow I hd hx r.2).1 hr)
    rw [← J.ucost_eq I hd hc r.2, hcost] at h1
    exact h1

name: Goemans.GraphInstance.toFlowInstance_optimalUCost
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFlowInstance_optimalUCost (J : GraphInstance ℝ) :
    J.toFlowInstance.optimalUCost = J.optimalUCost

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.toGraph_optimalUCost

proof:
:=
  I.toGraph.optimalUCost_eq I rfl rfl I.toGraph_x

      ∀ i j : Terminal, i ≠ j → ![l0, l1, l2] i = gateZ i → ![l0, l1, l2] j = gateZ j →

        GateAdmissible ![l0, l1, l2] → 200 ≤ gateCost ![l0, l1, l2]

  funext i

name: Goemans.gate_collapse_min
statement:
theorem gate_collapse_min :
    ∀ r : Terminal → List GateArc, IsGateRouting r → GateAdmissible r →
      100 ≤ gateCost r
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr hadm
  rw [← components_eq r] at hadm ⊢
  exact gate_min_check (r 0) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 0 (r 0)).1 (hr 0))
    (r 1) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 1 (r 1)).1 (hr 1))
    (r 2) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 2 (r 2)).1 (hr 2)) hadm

name: Goemans.gate_pairs_blocked
statement:
theorem gate_pairs_blocked :
    ∀ r : Terminal → List GateArc, IsGateRouting r →
      ∀ i j : Terminal, i ≠ j → r i = gateZ i → r j = gateZ j →
        ¬ GateAdmissible r
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr i j hij hi hj
  rw [← components_eq r] at hi hj ⊢
  exact gate_pairs_check (r 0) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 0 (r 0)).1 (hr 0))
    (r 1) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 1 (r 1)).1 (hr 1))
    (r 2) ((gateWalk_terminal_iff 2 (r 2)).1 (hr 2)) i j hij hi hj

name: Goemans.gate_designed_min
statement:

    ∀ r : Terminal → List GateArc, (∀ i, r i = gateZ i ∨ r i = [gateDirect i]) →
      GateAdmissible r → 200 ≤ gateCost r
proof:
:= by
  intro r hdes hadm
  rw [← components_eq r] at hadm ⊢
  refine gate_designed_check (r 0) ?_ (r 1) ?_ (r 2) ?_ hadm
  · rcases hdes 0 with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · rcases hdes 1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · rcases hdes 2 with h | h <;> simp [h]

statement:
theorem gate_collapse_ratio_lt_one :
    (gateCost spliceRouting : ℝ) / (gateFCost : ℝ) = (100 : ℝ) / 153 ∧
      (gateCost spliceRouting : ℝ) / (gateFCost : ℝ) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [spliceRouting_spec.2, gateFCost_eq]
  norm_num

name: Goemans.gate_collapse
statement:
theorem gate_collapse :
    gateFCost = 153 ∧
      (IsGateRouting spliceRouting ∧ GateAdmissible spliceRouting ∧
        gateCost spliceRouting = 100) ∧
      (∀ r, IsGateRouting r → GateAdmissible r → 100 ≤ gateCost r) ∧
      (IsGateRouting ![[gateDirect 0], [gateDirect 1], gateZ 2] ∧
        GateAdmissible ![[gateDirect 0], [gateDirect 1], gateZ 2] ∧
        gateCost ![[gateDirect 0], [gateDirect 1], gateZ 2] = 200) ∧
      (∀ r, (∀ i, r i = gateZ i ∨ r i = [gateDirect i]) → GateAdmissible r →
        200 ≤ gateCost r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨gateFCost_eq, ⟨spliceRouting_isRouting, spliceRouting_spec.1, spliceRouting_spec.2⟩,
    gate_collapse_min, gate_designed_attained_strong, gate_designed_min⟩

name: Goemans.IsWalk.append
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases h₁
    exact h₂
  | cons e l ih =>
    exact ⟨h₁.1, ih h₁.2⟩

  | nil => exact ⟨a, rfl, h⟩

name: Goemans.IsWalk.end_mem_vertexTrace
statement:
theorem end_mem_vertexTrace {a b : V} {l : List A}
    (h : IsWalk src dst a b l) : b ∈ vertexTrace dst a l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [vertexTrace, h.symm]
  | cons e l ih =>
    have h' := ih h.2
    simp only [vertexTrace, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons] at h' ⊢

name: Goemans.IsWalk.rank_add_length_le
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    have hab : a = b := h
    simp [hab]
  | cons e l ih =>
    have h1 := hrank e
    have h2 := ih h.2
    rw [h.1] at h1
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

name: Goemans.IsWalk.eq_nil_of_self
proof:
:= by

  have h2 : l.length = 0 := by omega
  exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero h2

name: Goemans.IsWalk.exists_prefix_of_mem_vertexTrace
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[], [], rfl, ?_⟩
    simp only [vertexTrace, List.map_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hv
    exact hv.symm
  | cons e l ih =>
    simp only [vertexTrace, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons] at hv
    rcases hv with hva | hv'
    · exact ⟨[], e :: l, rfl, hva.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, hl, hw⟩ := ih h.2 (by simpa [vertexTrace] using hv')
      exact ⟨e :: l₁, l₂, by rw [hl, List.cons_append], h.1, hw⟩

name: Goemans.IsWalk.exists_prefix_cons_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp he
  obtain ⟨v, hq, her⟩ := append_inv h
  exact ⟨q, r, rfl, by simpa only [her.1] using hq⟩

name: Goemans.IsWalk.exists_prefix_through_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_through_of_mem {a b : V} {l : List A} {e : A}
    (h : IsWalk src dst a b l) (he : e ∈ l) :
    ∃ q r, l = (q ++ [e]) ++ r ∧
      IsWalk src dst a (dst e) (q ++ [e])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hq⟩ := h.exists_prefix_cons_of_mem he
  refine ⟨q, r, ?_, hq.append ?_⟩
  · simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hqr
  · exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.IsWalk.prefix_unique
proof:
:= by
  induction q₁ generalizing a q₂ with
  | nil =>
    have hv : a = v := hw₁
    subst hv
    exact (eq_nil_of_self hrank hw₂).symm
  | cons e q₁ ih =>
    cases q₂ with
    | nil =>
      have hv : a = v := hw₂
      subst hv
      exact absurd (eq_nil_of_self hrank hw₁) (by simp)
    | cons f q₂ =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at hq
      obtain ⟨rfl, hq'⟩ := hq
      rw [ih hq' hw₁.2 hw₂.2]

name: Goemans.splice_prefix_eq
statement:
theorem splice_prefix_eq (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {sV ti v : V} {Zi Zj p ri rj qi si qj sj : List A}
    (hZi : IsWalk src dst sV ti Zi)
    (hpi : Zi = p ++ ri) (hpj : Zj = p ++ rj)
    (hcommon : ∀ x, x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zi → x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zj →
      x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV p)
    (hqi : Zi = qi ++ si) (hwi : IsWalk src dst sV v qi)
    (hqj : Zj = qj ++ sj) (hwj : IsWalk src dst sV v qj) :
    qj = qi
proof:
:= by
  
  have hvZi : v ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zi := by
    rw [hqi, vertexTrace_append]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hwi.end_mem_vertexTrace
  have hvZj : v ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zj := by
    rw [hqj, vertexTrace_append]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hwj.end_mem_vertexTrace
  have hvp : v ∈ vertexTrace dst sV p := hcommon v hvZi hvZj
  
  obtain ⟨m, hpm, -⟩ := IsWalk.append_inv (hpi ▸ hZi)
  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, hp12, hwp1⟩ := hpm.exists_prefix_of_mem_vertexTrace hvp
  
  have hqi_eq : qi = p₁ :=
    IsWalk.prefix_unique hrank
      (by rw [← hqi, hpi, hp12, List.append_assoc]) hwi hwp1
  have hqj_eq : qj = p₁ :=
    IsWalk.prefix_unique hrank
      (by rw [← hqj, hpj, hp12, List.append_assoc]) hwj hwp1
  rw [hqi_eq, hqj_eq]

name: Goemans.splice_eq
statement:
theorem splice_eq (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {sV ti v : V} {Zi Zj p ri rj qi si qj sj : List A}
    (hZi : IsWalk src dst sV ti Zi)
    (hpi : Zi = p ++ ri) (hpj : Zj = p ++ rj)
    (hcommon : ∀ x, x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zi → x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV Zj →
      x ∈ vertexTrace dst sV p)
    (hqi : Zi = qi ++ si) (hwi : IsWalk src dst sV v qi)
    (hqj : Zj = qj ++ sj) (hwj : IsWalk src dst sV v qj) :
    qj ++ si = Zi
proof:
:= by
  rw [splice_prefix_eq hrank hZi hpi hpj hcommon hqi hwi hqj hwj]
  exact hqi.symm

name: Goemans.CommonInitialPrefix.refl
statement:
@[refl] theorem CommonInitialPrefix.refl (dst : A → V) (sV : V) (Z : List A) :

name: Goemans.CommonInitialPrefix.symm
statement:
@[symm] theorem CommonInitialPrefix.symm
    {dst : A → V} {sV : V} {Zi Zj : List A}

    CommonInitialPrefix dst sV Zj Zi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ri, rj, hpi, hpj, hcommon⟩ := h
  exact ⟨p, rj, ri, hpj, hpi, fun x hxj hxi => hcommon x hxi hxj⟩

name: Goemans.PairwiseNoReconvergence.of_ne
statement:
theorem PairwiseNoReconvergence.of_ne
    {dst : A → V} {sV : V} {Z : ι → List A}
    (hno : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → CommonInitialPrefix dst sV (Z i) (Z j)) :
    PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j

    exact CommonInitialPrefix.refl dst sV (Z i)

proof:
:= by

name: Goemans.path_prefix_eq
statement:
theorem path_prefix_eq
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (hno : PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z)
    {i j : ι} {v : V} {qi si qj sj : List A}
    (hqi : Z i = qi ++ si) (hwi : IsWalk src dst sV v qi)
    (hqj : Z j = qj ++ sj) (hwj : IsWalk src dst sV v qj) :
    qj = qi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ri, rj, hpi, hpj, hcommon⟩ := hno i j
  exact splice_prefix_eq hrank (hZ i) hpi hpj hcommon hqi hwi hqj hwj

name: Goemans.pathUnionArrow_rank_lt
statement:
theorem pathUnionArrow_rank_lt
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} {u v : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z}
    (e : u ⟶ v) :
    rank u.1 < rank v.1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [e.source_eq, e.target_eq] using hrank e.edge

name: Goemans.pathUnion_unique_incoming
statement:
theorem pathUnion_unique_incoming
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (hno : PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z)
    {u v w : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z}
    (e : u ⟶ w) (f : v ⟶ w) :
    u = v ∧ e ≍ f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hei⟩ := e.mem
  obtain ⟨j, hfj⟩ := f.mem
  obtain ⟨qi, si, hqi, hwi⟩ := (hZ i).exists_prefix_through_of_mem hei
  obtain ⟨qj, sj, hqj, hwj⟩ := (hZ j).exists_prefix_through_of_mem hfj
  have hwi' : IsWalk src dst sV w.1 (qi ++ [e.edge]) := by
    simpa only [e.target_eq] using hwi
  have hwj' : IsWalk src dst sV w.1 (qj ++ [f.edge]) := by
    simpa only [f.target_eq] using hwj
  have hpref : qj ++ [f.edge] = qi ++ [e.edge] :=
    path_prefix_eq hrank hZ hno hqi hwi' hqj hwj'
  have hedge : f.edge = e.edge := by
    have hrev := congrArg List.reverse hpref
    have hp := by
      simpa only [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_singleton, List.singleton_append,
        List.cons.injEq] using hrev
    exact hp.1
  have huv : u = v := by
    apply PathUnionVertex.ext
    rw [← e.source_eq, ← f.source_eq, hedge]
  refine ⟨huv, ?_⟩
  subst v
  apply heq_of_eq
  apply PathUnionArrow.ext
  exact hedge.symm

name: Goemans.pathUnion_root_or_incoming
statement:
theorem pathUnion_root_or_incoming
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (i₀ : ι) (v : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z) :
    v = pathUnionRoot src dst sV Z i₀ ∨
      ∃ u, Nonempty (u ⟶ v)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v.1 = sV
  · exact Or.inl (PathUnionVertex.ext hv)
  · rcases v.2 with ⟨i, hvi⟩
    simp only [vertexTrace, List.mem_cons] at hvi
    rcases hvi with hvi | hvi
    · exact False.elim (hv hvi)
    · obtain ⟨e, hei, hev⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hvi
      obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hq⟩ := (hZ i).exists_prefix_cons_of_mem hei
      have hsrc : src e ∈ vertexTrace dst sV (Z i) := by
        rw [hqr, vertexTrace_append]
        exact List.mem_append_left _ hq.end_mem_vertexTrace
      let u : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z := ⟨src e, ⟨i, hsrc⟩⟩
      refine Or.inr ⟨u, ⟨?_⟩⟩
      exact
        { edge := e
          mem := ⟨i, hei⟩
          source_eq := rfl
          target_eq := hev }

name: Goemans.pathUnion_arborescence_root
statement:
theorem pathUnion_arborescence_root
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (hno : PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z) (i₀ : ι) :
    (pathUnionArborescence hrank hZ hno i₀).root =
      pathUnionRoot src dst sV Z i₀
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathUnionArborescence Quiver.arborescenceMk
  rfl

name: Goemans.pathUnion_root_reachable
statement:
theorem pathUnion_root_reachable
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (hno : PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z) (i₀ : ι)
    (v : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z) :
    Nonempty (Quiver.Path (pathUnionRoot src dst sV Z i₀) v)
proof:
:= by
  have hUnique := (pathUnionArborescence hrank hZ hno i₀).uniquePath v
  rw [pathUnion_arborescence_root hrank hZ hno i₀] at hUnique
  exact ⟨hUnique.default⟩

name: Goemans.pathUnion_root_path_unique
statement:
theorem pathUnion_root_path_unique
    (hrank : ∀ e, rank (src e) < rank (dst e))
    {Z : ι → List A} (hZ : ∀ i, IsWalk src dst sV (terminal i) (Z i))
    (hno : PairwiseNoReconvergence dst sV Z) (i₀ : ι)
    {v : PathUnionVertex src dst sV Z}
    (p q : Quiver.Path (pathUnionRoot src dst sV Z i₀) v) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hUnique := (pathUnionArborescence hrank hZ hno i₀).uniquePath v
  rw [pathUnion_arborescence_root hrank hZ hno i₀] at hUnique
  exact (hUnique.uniq p).trans (hUnique.uniq q).symm

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.admissible_iff
statement:
theorem admissible_iff (S : Finset Terminal) :
    I.Admissible S ↔
      ((if 0 ∈ S then I.d 0 else 0) + (if 1 ∈ S then I.d 1 else 0)
          ≤ I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.dmax) ∧
      ((if 0 ∈ S then I.d 0 else 0) + (if 1 ∈ S then I.d 1 else 0) +
            (if 2 ∈ S then I.d 2 else 0)
          ≤ I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax) ∧
      ((if 1 ∈ S then I.d 1 else 0) + (if 2 ∈ S then I.d 2 else 0)
          ≤ I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 := I.d_le_dmax 0
  have hd1 := I.d_le_dmax 1
  have hd2 := I.d_le_dmax 2
  have hf0 := I.f_nonneg 0
  have hf1 := I.f_nonneg 1
  have hf2 := I.f_nonneg 2
  have hfd0 := I.f_le_d 0
  have hfd1 := I.f_le_d 1
  have hfd2 := I.f_le_d 2
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := h Arc.su
    have h2 := h Arc.uv
    have h3 := h Arc.vw
    rw [load_su, x_su] at h1
    rw [load_uv, x_uv] at h2
    rw [load_vw, x_vw] at h3
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ a
    cases a <;>
      simp only [load_st1, load_st2, load_su, load_ut3, load_uv, load_vt1,
        load_vw, load_wt2, load_wt3, x_st1, x_st2, x_su, x_ut3, x_uv, x_vt1,
        x_vw, x_wt2, x_wt3] <;>
      split_ifs at h1 h2 h3 ⊢ <;> linarith

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.admissible_empty
statement: theorem admissible_empty : I.Admissible ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [admissible_iff]
  have hf0 := I.f_nonneg 0
  have hf1 := I.f_nonneg 1
  have hf2 := I.f_nonneg 2
  have hD := I.dmax_pos
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, if_false]
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.adm_single0

  have hf2 := I.f_nonneg 2

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> linarith

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.admissible_mono
statement:
theorem admissible_mono {S T : Finset Terminal} (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (hT : I.Admissible T) : I.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  rw [admissible_iff] at hT ⊢
  have key : ∀ i : Terminal,
      (if i ∈ S then I.d i else 0) ≤ (if i ∈ T then I.d i else 0) := by
    intro i
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact le_refl _
    · exact absurd (hST h1) h2
    · exact le_of_lt (I.d_pos i)
    · exact le_refl _
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨by linarith [key 0, key 1], by linarith [key 0, key 1, key 2],
    by linarith [key 1, key 2]⟩

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.blocked_pair01_lt
statement:

    I.f 0 + I.f 1 < I.d 0 + I.d 1 - I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hc
  refine h ?_
  rw [admissible_iff]
  have hd1 := I.d_le_dmax 1
  have hf1 := I.f_nonneg 1
  have hf2 := I.f_nonneg 2

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.blocked_triple
statement:
theorem blocked_triple (h01 : I.Admissible {0, 1}) (h12 : I.Admissible {1, 2})
    (h : ¬ I.Admissible Finset.univ) :
    I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax < I.d 0 + I.d 1 + I.d 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hc
  refine h ?_
  rw [admissible_iff] at h01 h12 ⊢
  have h01a :
      I.d 0 + I.d 1 ≤ I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.dmax := by
    simpa using h01.1
  have h12c :
      I.d 1 + I.d 2 ≤ I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax := by
    simpa using h12.2.2
  have hall :
      I.d 0 + I.d 1 ≤ I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.dmax ∧
        I.d 0 + I.d 1 + I.d 2 ≤
          I.f 0 + I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax ∧
        I.d 1 + I.d 2 ≤ I.f 1 + I.f 2 + I.dmax :=
    ⟨h01a, hc, h12c⟩
  simpa using hall

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.sum_arc
statement:
private theorem sum_arc (g : I.CompleteArc → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, g a) =
      (∑ t, ∑ l, g (.lane t l)) +
        ((∑ i, g (.cheapExit i)) + ∑ i, g (.expensiveExit i))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a, g a) =
        ∑ a : (Sigma fun t : Fin m => Fin (I.lanes t)) ⊕ (Fin k ⊕ Fin k),
          g ((arcEquiv k m I.lanes).symm a) :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (arcEquiv k m I.lanes) g
        (fun a => g ((arcEquiv k m I.lanes).symm a)) (fun a => by simp)
    _ = (∑ t, ∑ l, g (.lane t l)) +
          ((∑ i, g (.cheapExit i)) + ∑ i, g (.expensiveExit i)) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_sigma, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.d_le_dmax
statement: theorem d_le_dmax (i : Fin k) : I.d i ≤ I.dmax
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup' I.d (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.dmax_pos
statement: theorem dmax_pos : 0 < I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin k := ⟨0, I.terminal_nonempty⟩

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.arcCost_nonneg
statement: theorem arcCost_nonneg (a : I.CompleteArc) : 0 ≤ I.arcCost a
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | lane _ _ => simp [arcCost]
  | cheapExit _ => simp [arcCost]
  | expensiveExit i => simpa [arcCost] using I.c_nonneg i

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.fractionalCost_eq_sum_arc
