:= by
  rw [sum_arc]
  simp [fractionalCost, arcCost, x]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.load_lane
statement:
@[simp] theorem load_lane (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing)
    (t : Fin m) (l : Fin (I.lanes t)) :
    I.load S R (.lane t l) = I.laneLoad S R t l
proof:
:= by
  rw [load, laneLoad]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : I.Transits S i t ∧ R.lane t i = l <;>
    simp [UsesArc, h]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.load_cheapExit
statement:
@[simp] theorem load_cheapExit (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing)
    (i : Fin k) :
    I.load S R (.cheapExit i) = if i ∈ S then I.d i else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    rw [load]
    calc
      (∑ j, if I.UsesArc S R j (.cheapExit i) then I.d j else 0) =
          (if I.UsesArc S R i (.cheapExit i) then I.d i else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
            · intro j _ hji
              simp [UsesArc, hji]
            · simp
      _ = I.d i := by simp [UsesArc, hi]
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    rw [load]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [UsesArc, hi]
    · simp [UsesArc, hji]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.load_expensiveExit
statement:
@[simp] theorem load_expensiveExit (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing)
    (i : Fin k) :
    I.load S R (.expensiveExit i) = if i ∈ S then 0 else I.d i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    rw [load]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [UsesArc, hi]
    · simp [UsesArc, hji]
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    rw [load]
    calc
      (∑ j, if I.UsesArc S R j (.expensiveExit i) then I.d j else 0) =
          (if I.UsesArc S R i (.expensiveExit i) then I.d i else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
            · intro j _ hji
              simp [UsesArc, hji]
            · simp
      _ = I.d i := by simp [UsesArc, hi]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.routingCost_eq_sum_arc
statement:
theorem routingCost_eq_sum_arc
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing) :
    I.routingCost S = ∑ a, I.arcCost a * I.load S R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_arc]
  simp [routingCost, arcCost]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.x_lane
statement:
@[simp] theorem x_lane (t : Fin m) (l : Fin (I.lanes t)) :
    I.x (.lane t l) = I.laneX t l
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.x_cheapExit
statement:
@[simp] theorem x_cheapExit (i : Fin k) :
    I.x (.cheapExit i) = I.f i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.x_expensiveExit
statement:
@[simp] theorem x_expensiveExit (i : Fin k) :
    I.x (.expensiveExit i) = I.d i - I.f i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.x_nonneg
statement: theorem x_nonneg (a : I.CompleteArc) : 0 ≤ I.x a
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | lane t l => exact I.laneX_nonneg t l
  | cheapExit i => exact I.f_nonneg i
  | expensiveExit i => exact sub_nonneg.mpr (I.f_le_d i)

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.load_nonneg
statement:
theorem load_nonneg (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing) (a : I.CompleteArc) :
    0 ≤ I.load S R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [load]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by
    split <;> simp [(I.d_pos i).le]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.cheapExit_safe
statement:
theorem cheapExit_safe (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing) (i : Fin k) :
    I.load S R (.cheapExit i) ≤ I.x (.cheapExit i) + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  rw [load_cheapExit, x_cheapExit]
  split_ifs
  · linarith [I.f_nonneg i, I.d_le_dmax i]
  · linarith [I.f_nonneg i, I.dmax_pos]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.expensiveExit_safe
statement:
theorem expensiveExit_safe (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing) (i : Fin k) :
    I.load S R (.expensiveExit i) ≤ I.x (.expensiveExit i) + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  rw [load_expensiveExit, x_expensiveExit]
  split_ifs
  · linarith [I.f_le_d i, I.dmax_pos]
  · linarith [I.f_le_d i, I.d_le_dmax i]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.admissible_iff_lanes
statement:
theorem admissible_iff_lanes (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : I.Routing) :
    I.Admissible S R ↔
      ∀ t l, I.laneLoad S R t l ≤ I.laneX t l + I.dmax
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t l
    simpa using h (.lane t l)
  · intro h a
    cases a with
    | lane t l => simpa using h t l
    | cheapExit i => exact I.cheapExit_safe S R i
    | expensiveExit i => exact I.expensiveExit_safe S R i

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.exists_admissibleRouting_iff_forall_stageCanPack
statement:
theorem exists_admissibleRouting_iff_forall_stageCanPack
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (∃ R : I.Routing, I.Admissible S R) ↔
      ∀ t, I.StageCanPack S t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, hR⟩ t
    refine ⟨{ lane := R.lane t, capacity := ?_ }⟩
    intro l
    exact (I.admissible_iff_lanes S R).1 hR t l
  · intro hpack
    classical
    let P : ∀ t, I.StagePacking S t := fun t => Classical.choice (hpack t)
    let R : I.Routing := ⟨fun t => (P t).lane⟩
    refine ⟨R, (I.admissible_iff_lanes S R).2 ?_⟩
    intro t l
    exact (P t).capacity l

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_lanes
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofChain_lanes [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m) (t : Fin m) :
    (ofChain C).lanes t = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_laneX
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofChain_laneX [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m) (t : Fin m)
    (l : Fin ((ofChain C).lanes t)) :
    (ofChain C).laneX t l = C.stageX t
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_dmax
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofChain_dmax [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m) :
    (ofChain C).dmax = C.dmax
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_laneLoad
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofChain_laneLoad [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m)
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : (ofChain C).Routing)
    (t : Fin m) (l : Fin ((ofChain C).lanes t)) :
    (ofChain C).laneLoad S R t l = C.stageLoad S t
proof:
:= by
  rw [laneLoad, Chain.Instance.stageLoad]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hline : R.lane t i = l := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hR := (R.lane t i).isLt
    change (R.lane t i).val < 1 at hR
    have hl := l.isLt
    change l.val < 1 at hl
    exact (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hR).trans (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hl).symm
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · simp [Transits, exitPos, ofChain, hi, hline]
  · simp [Transits, exitPos, ofChain, hi, hline]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_admissible_iff
statement:
theorem ofChain_admissible_iff [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m)
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) (R : (ofChain C).Routing) :
    (ofChain C).Admissible S R ↔ C.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  rw [(ofChain C).admissible_iff_lanes, C.admissible_iff_stage]
  simp

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.ofChain_exists_admissibleRouting_iff
statement:
theorem ofChain_exists_admissibleRouting_iff [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (C : Chain.Instance (Fin k) m) (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (∃ R : (ofChain C).Routing, (ofChain C).Admissible S R) ↔
      C.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, hR⟩
    exact (ofChain_admissible_iff C S R).1 hR
  · intro hC
    let R : (ofChain C).Routing :=
      ⟨fun _ _ => ⟨0, by simp [ofChain]⟩⟩
    exact ⟨R, (ofChain_admissible_iff C S R).2 hC⟩

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.transits_zero_iff_mem
statement:
theorem transits_zero_iff_mem
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) :
    I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ↔ i ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;>
    simp [Transits, exitPos, he i, hp i, hi]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.dmax_eq_one
statement:
theorem dmax_eq_one (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1) :
    I.dmax = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [dmax, Finset.sup'_le_iff]
    intro i _
    rw [hd i]
  · let i : Fin k := ⟨0, I.terminal_nonempty⟩
    simpa [hd i] using I.d_le_dmax i

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.stageCanPack_zero_iff_card_le
statement:
theorem stageCanPack_zero_iff_card_le
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1)
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    I.StageCanPack S (0 : Fin 1) ↔ S.card ≤ I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P⟩
    let assign : {i // i ∈ S} → Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)) :=
      fun i => P.lane i.1
    have hinjective : Function.Injective assign := by
      intro a b hab
      let fiber : Finset (Fin k) :=
        Finset.univ.filter fun i =>
          I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧ P.lane i = P.lane a.1
      have hload :
          (∑ i, if I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧
              P.lane i = P.lane a.1 then I.d i else 0) =
            (fiber.card : ℝ) := by
        calc
          (∑ i, if I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧
              P.lane i = P.lane a.1 then I.d i else 0) =
              ∑ i ∈ fiber, I.d i := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          _ = ∑ _i ∈ fiber, (1 : ℝ) := by simp [hd]
          _ = (fiber.card : ℝ) := by simp
      have hcapacity := P.capacity (P.lane a.1)
      rw [hload, I.dmax_eq_one hd] at hcapacity
      have hcard_lt_real : (fiber.card : ℝ) < 2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hcapacity (by
          linarith [hxlt (P.lane a.1)])
      have hcard_lt : fiber.card < 2 :=
        (Nat.cast_lt (α := ℝ)).mp (by simpa using hcard_lt_real)
      have hcard : fiber.card ≤ 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hcard_lt
      have ha : a.1 ∈ fiber := by
        simp [fiber, I.transits_zero_iff_mem he hp S, a.2]
      have hb : b.1 ∈ fiber := by
        change P.lane a.1 = P.lane b.1 at hab
        simp [fiber, I.transits_zero_iff_mem he hp S, b.2, hab.symm]
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard a.1 ha b.1 hb
    have hcard :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective assign hinjective
    simpa using hcard
  · intro hcard
    have hembedding :
        Nonempty ({i // i ∈ S} ↪ Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1))) :=
      Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa using hcard)
    let emb : {i // i ∈ S} ↪ Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)) :=
      Classical.choice hembedding
    let fallback : Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)) :=
      ⟨0, I.lane_nonempty (0 : Fin 1)⟩
    let assign : Fin k → Fin (I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)) :=
      fun i => if hi : i ∈ S then emb ⟨i, hi⟩ else fallback
    refine ⟨⟨assign, ?_⟩⟩
    intro l
    let fiber : Finset (Fin k) :=
      Finset.univ.filter fun i =>
        I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧ assign i = l
    have hfiber : fiber.card ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_le_one]
      intro a ha b hb
      have ha' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
      have hb' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
      have haS : a ∈ S :=
        (I.transits_zero_iff_mem he hp S a).mp ha'.1
      have hbS : b ∈ S :=
        (I.transits_zero_iff_mem he hp S b).mp hb'.1
      have hab_assign : assign a = assign b := ha'.2.trans hb'.2.symm
      have hab_emb : emb ⟨a, haS⟩ = emb ⟨b, hbS⟩ := by
        simpa [assign, haS, hbS] using hab_assign
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (emb.injective hab_emb)
    calc
      (∑ i, if I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧ assign i = l then I.d i else 0) =
          (fiber.card : ℝ) := by
            calc
              (∑ i, if I.Transits S i (0 : Fin 1) ∧
                  assign i = l then I.d i else 0) =
                  ∑ i ∈ fiber, I.d i := by
                    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
              _ = ∑ _i ∈ fiber, (1 : ℝ) := by simp [hd]
              _ = (fiber.card : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mpr hfiber
      _ ≤ I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l + I.dmax := by
        rw [I.dmax_eq_one hd]
        linarith [I.laneX_nonneg (0 : Fin 1) l]

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.exists_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_le
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1)
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (∃ R : I.Routing, I.Admissible S R) ↔
      S.card ≤ I.lanes (0 : Fin 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.exists_admissibleRouting_iff_forall_stageCanPack]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (I.stageCanPack_zero_iff_card_le hd he hp hxlt S).1
      (h (0 : Fin 1))
  · intro h t
    have ht : t = (0 : Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst t
    exact (I.stageCanPack_zero_iff_card_le hd he hp hxlt S).2 h

name: Goemans.Laned.Instance.no_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_gt
statement:
theorem no_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_gt
    (hd : ∀ i, I.d i = 1)
    (he : ∀ i, I.e i = (0 : Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, I.p i = (1 : Fin 2))
    (hxlt : ∀ l, I.laneX (0 : Fin 1) l < 1)
    (S : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (¬ ∃ R : I.Routing, I.Admissible S R) ↔
      I.lanes (0 : Fin 1) < S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.exists_admissibleRouting_zero_iff_card_le hd he hp hxlt S]
  exact Nat.not_le

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.mem_admissibleRoutings
statement:
theorem mem_admissibleRoutings (I : Instance ι m) (S : Finset ι) :
    S ∈ I.admissibleRoutings ↔ I.Admissible S
proof:
:= by
  simp [admissibleRoutings]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissibleRoutings_nonempty
statement:
theorem admissibleRoutings_nonempty (I : Instance ι m) :
    I.admissibleRoutings.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, I.mem_admissibleRoutings ∅ |>.2 I.admissible_empty⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.admissibleCosts_nonempty
statement:
private theorem admissibleCosts_nonempty (I : Instance ι m) :
    I.admissibleCosts.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  I.admissibleRoutings_nonempty.image I.routingCost

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.exists_optimalRouting
statement:
theorem exists_optimalRouting (I : Instance ι m) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι,
      I.Admissible S ∧ I.routingCost S = I.optimalRoutingCost
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : I.optimalRoutingCost ∈ I.admissibleCosts :=
    Finset.min'_mem _ I.admissibleCosts_nonempty
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmem with ⟨S, hS, hcost⟩
  exact ⟨S, (I.mem_admissibleRoutings S).1 hS, hcost⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.optimalRoutingCost_le
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.min'_le
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨S, (I.mem_admissibleRoutings S).2 hS, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.routingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem routingCost_nonneg (I : Instance ι m) (S : Finset ι) :
    0 ≤ I.routingCost S
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact mul_nonneg (I.c_nonneg i) (I.d_pos i).le

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.optimalRoutingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem optimalRoutingCost_nonneg (I : Instance ι m) :
    0 ≤ I.optimalRoutingCost
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, _, hcost⟩ := I.exists_optimalRouting
  rw [← hcost]
  exact I.routingCost_nonneg S

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.demand_le_dmax
statement:
theorem demand_le_dmax (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    (q : ι ⊕ κ) :
    demand I J q ≤ dmax I J
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with i | j
  · exact le_trans (I.d_le_dmax i) (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact le_trans (J.d_le_dmax j) (le_max_right _ _)

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.dmax_eq_sup_demand
statement:
theorem dmax_eq_sup_demand (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n) :
    dmax I J =
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (demand I J)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply max_le
    · change
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty I.d ≤
          Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (demand I J)
      apply Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty
      intro i _
      exact Finset.le_sup' (demand I J) (Finset.mem_univ (Sum.inl i))
    · change
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty J.d ≤
          Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (demand I J)
      apply Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty
      intro j _
      exact Finset.le_sup' (demand I J) (Finset.mem_univ (Sum.inr j))
  · apply Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro q _
    exact demand_le_dmax I J q

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.fractionalCost_eq_sum_arc
statement:
theorem fractionalCost_eq_sum_arc (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n) :
    fractionalCost I J =
      ∑ a : Arc ι κ m n, arcCost I J a * x I J a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [fractionalCost, arcCost, x]
  rw [← I.fractionalCost_eq_sum_arc, ← J.fractionalCost_eq_sum_arc]

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.routingCost_eq_sum_arc
statement:
theorem routingCost_eq_sum_arc (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    (R : Routing ι κ) :
    routingCost I J R =
      ∑ a : Arc ι κ m n, arcCost I J a * load I J R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [routingCost, arcCost, load]
  rw [← I.routingCost_eq_sum_arc, ← J.routingCost_eq_sum_arc]

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.admissible_iff
statement:
theorem admissible_iff (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    (R : Routing ι κ) :
    Admissible I J R ↔
      (∀ a, I.load R.1 a ≤ I.x a + dmax I J) ∧
      (∀ a, J.load R.2 a ≤ J.x a + dmax I J)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun a => h (.inl a), fun a => h (.inr a)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hI, hJ⟩ (a | a)
    · exact hI a
    · exact hJ a

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.admissible_of_components
statement:
theorem admissible_of_components (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    {S : Finset ι} {T : Finset κ}
    (hS : I.Admissible S) (hT : J.Admissible T) :
    Admissible I J (S, T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [admissible_iff]
  constructor
  · intro a
    have hmax := le_max_left I.dmax J.dmax
    simp only [dmax]
    linarith [hS a]
  · intro a
    have hmax := le_max_right I.dmax J.dmax
    simp only [dmax]
    linarith [hT a]

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.mem_admissibleRoutings
statement:
theorem mem_admissibleRoutings (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    (R : Routing ι κ) :
    R ∈ admissibleRoutings I J ↔ Admissible I J R
proof:
:= by
  simp [admissibleRoutings]

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.admissibleRoutings_nonempty
statement:
theorem admissibleRoutings_nonempty (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n) :
    (admissibleRoutings I J).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨(∅, ∅), (mem_admissibleRoutings I J _).2
    (admissible_of_components I J I.admissible_empty J.admissible_empty)⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.admissibleCosts_nonempty
statement:
private theorem admissibleCosts_nonempty
    (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n) :
    (admissibleCosts I J).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  (admissibleRoutings_nonempty I J).image (routingCost I J)

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.optimalRoutingCost_le
statement:
theorem optimalRoutingCost_le (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    {R : Routing ι κ} (hR : Admissible I J R) :
    optimalRoutingCost I J ≤ routingCost I J R
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.min'_le
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨R, (mem_admissibleRoutings I J R).2 hR, rfl⟩

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.optimalRoutingCost_le_add
statement:
theorem optimalRoutingCost_le_add (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n) :
    optimalRoutingCost I J ≤ I.optimalRoutingCost + J.optimalRoutingCost
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hScost⟩ := I.exists_optimalRouting
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTcost⟩ := J.exists_optimalRouting
  calc
    optimalRoutingCost I J ≤ routingCost I J (S, T) :=
      optimalRoutingCost_le I J (admissible_of_components I J hS hT)
    _ = I.optimalRoutingCost + J.optimalRoutingCost := by
      simp only [routingCost, hScost, hTcost]

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.add_div_add_le_max_div
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : U₁ ≤ max (U₁ / F₁) (U₂ / F₂) * F₁ :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hF₁).1 (le_max_left _ _)
  have h₂ : U₂ ≤ max (U₁ / F₁) (U₂ / F₂) * F₂ :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hF₂).1 (le_max_right _ _)
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (add_pos hF₁ hF₂)]
  nlinarith

name: Goemans.Chain.Parallel.ratio_le_max
statement:
theorem ratio_le_max (I : Instance ι m) (J : Instance κ n)
    (hI : 0 < I.fractionalCost) (hJ : 0 < J.fractionalCost) :
    ratio I J ≤ max I.ratio J.ratio
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 0 < fractionalCost I J := add_pos hI hJ
  calc
    ratio I J ≤
        (I.optimalRoutingCost + J.optimalRoutingCost) /
          fractionalCost I J := by
      rw [ratio]
      exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hsum).2
        (optimalRoutingCost_le_add I J)
    _ ≤ max I.ratio J.ratio := by
      exact add_div_add_le_max_div hI hJ

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.dummyEmbed_stageX_last

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.dummyEmbed_admissible_iff
statement:
theorem dummyEmbed_admissible_iff (I : Instance ι m) (δ : ℝ)
    (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) (hδ_le : δ ≤ I.dmax)
    (T : Finset (ι ⊕ PUnit)) :
    (I.dummyEmbed δ hδ_pos hδ_le).Admissible T ↔
      I.Admissible (restrictRouting T)
proof:
:= by
  let E := I.dummyEmbed δ hδ_pos hδ_le
  rw [E.admissible_iff_stage, I.admissible_iff_stage]
  constructor
  · intro h t
    have ht := h t.castSucc
    simp only [E, dummyEmbed_stageLoad_castSucc,
      dummyEmbed_stageX_castSucc, dummyEmbed_dmax] at ht
    linarith
  · intro h t
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun s => ?_) t
    · simp only [E, dummyEmbed_stageLoad_last, dummyEmbed_stageX_last,
        dummyEmbed_dmax, zero_add]
      split_ifs
      · exact hδ_le
      · exact I.dmax_pos.le
    · simp only [E, dummyEmbed_stageLoad_castSucc,
        dummyEmbed_stageX_castSucc, dummyEmbed_dmax]
      linarith [h s]

name: Goemans.Chain.Instance.dummyEmbed_optimalRoutingCost
statement:
@[simp] theorem dummyEmbed_optimalRoutingCost (I : Instance ι m) (δ : ℝ)
    (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) (hδ_le : δ ≤ I.dmax) :
    (I.dummyEmbed δ hδ_pos hδ_le).optimalRoutingCost =
      I.optimalRoutingCost
proof:
:= by
  let E := I.dummyEmbed δ hδ_pos hδ_le
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hcost⟩ := I.exists_optimalRouting
    calc
      E.optimalRoutingCost ≤ E.routingCost (liftRouting S) :=
        E.optimalRoutingCost_le
          ((I.dummyEmbed_admissible_lift_iff δ hδ_pos hδ_le S).2 hS)
      _ = I.routingCost S := by
        simp only [E, dummyEmbed_routingCost_lift]
      _ = I.optimalRoutingCost := hcost
  · obtain ⟨T, hT, hcost⟩ := E.exists_optimalRouting
    calc
      I.optimalRoutingCost ≤ I.routingCost (restrictRouting T) :=
        I.optimalRoutingCost_le
          ((I.dummyEmbed_admissible_iff δ hδ_pos hδ_le T).1 hT)
      _ = E.routingCost T := by
        simp only [E, dummyEmbed_routingCost_restrict]
      _ = E.optimalRoutingCost := hcost

name: Goemans.Chain.ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_succ
statement:
theorem ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_succ (k : ℕ) :
    ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} k ⊆
      ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  rcases hr with
    ⟨ι, instFintype, instDecidableEq, instNonempty, m, I, hcard, hcost, hratio⟩
  letI : Fintype ι := instFintype
  letI : DecidableEq ι := instDecidableEq
  letI : Nonempty ι := instNonempty
  let E := I.dummyEmbed I.dmax I.dmax_pos le_rfl
  refine ⟨ι ⊕ PUnit, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    m + 1, E, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_punit, hcard]
  · simpa only [E, Instance.dummyEmbed_fractionalCost] using hcost
  · simpa only [E, Instance.dummyEmbed_ratio] using hratio

name: Goemans.Chain.ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_add
statement:
theorem ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_add (k q : ℕ) :
    ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} k ⊆
      ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} (k + q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using
        (Set.Subset.rfl : ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} k ⊆
          ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} k)
  | succ q ih =>
      exact Set.Subset.trans ih
        (ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_succ.{u} (k + q))

name: Goemans.Chain.ratiosWithTerminalCount_three_subset
statement:

      ratiosWithTerminalCount.{u} k
proof:
:= by
  have hadd : 3 + (k - 3) = k := Nat.add_sub_of_le hk
  simpa only [hadd] using
    ratiosWithTerminalCount_subset_add.{u} 3 (k - 3)

name: Goemans.pellFamily_ratio_formula
statement:
theorem pellFamily_ratio_formula (n : ℕ) :
    (pellFamilyInstance n).ratio =
      (2 * (pellA n : ℝ) * (pellB n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) /
        ((((pellA n : ℝ) ^ 2 -
              (pellA n : ℝ) * (pellB n : ℝ) +
              2 * (pellB n : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) +
          2 * (pellB n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pellFamilyInstance, PositiveCostInstance.ratio]
  change
    (pellFamilyParams n).flow.toReal.optimalUCost /
        (pellFamilyParams n).flow.toReal.fcost = _
  rw [FamilyParams.flow_toReal]
  rw [FamilyParams.flow_optimalUCost, FamilyParams.flow_fcost]
  simp [FamilyParams.toReal]

    (by exact_mod_cast pellA_pos n)

name: Goemans.pellDelta_le_one

proof:
:= by

name: Goemans.pellFamily_ratio_normalized
statement:
theorem pellFamily_ratio_normalized (n : ℕ) :
    (pellFamilyInstance n).ratio =
      (2 * pellDelta n) /
        (1 - pellDelta n + 2 * pellDelta n ^ 2 +
          (2 * pellDelta n) / ((pellA n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pellFamily_ratio_formula]
  simp only [pellDelta]
  have ha : (pellA n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (pellA_pos n).ne'
  have hM : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Goemans.pell_error_eq_pow
statement:
theorem pell_error_eq_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (pellA n : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 2 * (pellB n : ℝ) =
      pellContraction ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [pellContraction]
      ring
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pellA_succ, pellB_succ]
      push_cast
      calc
        3 * (pellA n : ℝ) + 4 * (pellB n : ℝ) -
              Real.sqrt 2 *
                (2 * (pellA n : ℝ) + 3 * (pellB n : ℝ)) =
            pellContraction *
              ((pellA n : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 2 * (pellB n : ℝ)) := by
                rw [pellContraction]
                nlinarith [sqrt2_mul_self]
        _ = pellContraction * pellContraction ^ (n + 1) := by rw [ih]
        _ = pellContraction ^ (n + 1 + 1) := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          ring

name: Goemans.tendsto_pellError
statement:
private theorem tendsto_pellError :
    Tendsto (fun n => pellContraction ^ (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
      pellContraction_nonneg pellContraction_lt_one
  simpa [pow_succ] using hpow.mul_const pellContraction

name: Goemans.tendsto_pellDeltaCorrection
statement:
private theorem tendsto_pellDeltaCorrection :
    Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        pellContraction ^ (n + 1) /
          (Real.sqrt 2 * (pellA n : ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero
    (g := fun n => pellContraction ^ (n + 1) / Real.sqrt 2)
  · intro n
    exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg pellContraction_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg sqrt2_nonneg (by positivity))
  · intro n
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ pellA n := by exact_mod_cast one_le_pellA n
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg pellContraction_nonneg _) hs
    nlinarith
  · simpa using tendsto_pellError.div_const (Real.sqrt 2)

name: Goemans.pellDelta_eq
statement:
theorem pellDelta_eq (n : ℕ) :
    pellDelta n =
      1 / Real.sqrt 2 -
        pellContraction ^ (n + 1) /
          (Real.sqrt 2 * (pellA n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pellDelta]
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)).ne'
  have ha : (pellA n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (pellA_pos n).ne'
  field_simp [hs, ha]
  nlinarith [pell_error_eq_pow n]

name: Goemans.tendsto_pellDelta
statement:
theorem tendsto_pellDelta :
    Tendsto pellDelta atTop (𝓝 (1 / Real.sqrt 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ)) atTop
        (𝓝 (1 / Real.sqrt 2)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h := hconst.sub tendsto_pellDeltaCorrection
  have h' :
      Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          1 / Real.sqrt 2 -
            pellContraction ^ (n + 1) /
              (Real.sqrt 2 * (pellA n : ℝ)))
        atTop (𝓝 (1 / Real.sqrt 2)) := by
    simpa using h
  apply h'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with n
  rw [pellDelta_eq]

name: Goemans.tendsto_pellFamilyCorrection
statement:
private theorem tendsto_pellFamilyCorrection :
    Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (2 * pellDelta n) /
          ((pellA n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero (g := fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
  · intro n
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pellDelta_pos n).le)
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity))
  · intro n
    have hδle := pellDelta_le_one n
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ pellA n := by exact_mod_cast one_le_pellA n
    have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    apply div_le_div₀ (by norm_num) (by nlinarith) hMpos
    simpa using (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hMpos.le)
  · have hM : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 1) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hM
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 2) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    convert htwo.mul hinv using 1 <;> norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Goemans.pell_limit_identity
statement:
private theorem pell_limit_identity :
    (2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2)) /
        (1 - 1 / Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2) =
      rhoStar
proof:
:= by
  rw [rhoStar]
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)).ne'
  have hr : 2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := rhoStar_denom_pos.ne'
  have hd :
      1 - 1 / Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have hinvlt : 1 / Real.sqrt 2 < (1 : ℝ) := by
      simpa using (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
        one_lt_sqrt2)
    have hsquare : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  apply (div_eq_iff hd).2
  field_simp [hs, hr]
  nlinarith [sqrt2_mul_self]

name: Goemans.tendsto_pellFamily_ratio
statement:
theorem tendsto_pellFamily_ratio :
    Tendsto (fun n => (pellFamilyInstance n).ratio) atTop (𝓝 rhoStar)
proof:
:= by
  let delta : ℝ := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  have hdelta : Tendsto pellDelta atTop (𝓝 delta) := tendsto_pellDelta
  have hdenpos : 0 < 1 - delta + 2 * delta ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [delta]
    have hinvlt : 1 / Real.sqrt 2 < (1 : ℝ) := by
      simpa using (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
        one_lt_sqrt2)
    have hsquare : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hnum :
      Tendsto (fun n => 2 * pellDelta n) atTop (𝓝 (2 * delta)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul hdelta
  have hden :
      Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          1 - pellDelta n + 2 * pellDelta n ^ 2 +
            (2 * pellDelta n) /
              ((pellA n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
        atTop (𝓝 (1 - delta + 2 * delta ^ 2)) := by
    simpa using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub hdelta).add
        (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hdelta.pow 2))).add
          tendsto_pellFamilyCorrection
  have hratio :
      Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          (2 * pellDelta n) /
            (1 - pellDelta n + 2 * pellDelta n ^ 2 +
              (2 * pellDelta n) /
                ((pellA n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1))))
        atTop
        (𝓝 ((2 * delta) / (1 - delta + 2 * delta ^ 2))) :=
    hnum.div hden hdenpos.ne'
  have hlimit :
      (2 * delta) / (1 - delta + 2 * delta ^ 2) = rhoStar := by
    simpa [delta] using pell_limit_identity
  rw [hlimit] at hratio
  apply hratio.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with n
  exact (pellFamily_ratio_normalized n).symm

name: Goemans.pellFamily_ratio_mem
statement:
theorem pellFamily_ratio_mem (n : ℕ) :

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.af_nonneg
statement: theorem af_nonneg (i : Terminal) : 0 ≤ I.af i
proof:

proof:

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.blocked_af01

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.blocked_af02_lt

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.all_blocked_af_lt
statement:
theorem all_blocked_af_lt (h01 : ¬ I.Admissible {0, 1})
    (h12 : ¬ I.Admissible {1, 2})
    (h02 : ¬ I.Admissible {0, 2}) :
    2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 < I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2
proof:
:= by
  have key := splitLP_lt (I.d_pos 0) (I.d_pos 1) (I.d_pos 2)
    (I.f_nonneg 0) (I.f_nonneg 2)
    (I.f_le_d 0) (I.f_le_d 1) (I.f_le_d 2)
    (I.d_le_dmax 0) (I.d_le_dmax 1) (I.d_le_dmax 2)
    (I.blocked_pair01_lt h01) (I.blocked_pair12_lt h12).le
    (I.blocked_pair02_lt h02)
  simp only [af]
  linarith

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.triple_blocked_af_lt
statement:
theorem triple_blocked_af_lt (h01 : I.Admissible {0, 1})
    (h12 : I.Admissible {1, 2})
    (h : ¬ I.Admissible Finset.univ) :
    1 < I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb := I.blocked_triple h01 h12 h
  have t0 : 0 ≤ I.af 0 * (I.dmax - I.d 0) :=
    mul_nonneg (I.af_nonneg 0) (by linarith [I.d_le_dmax 0])
  have t1 : 0 ≤ I.af 1 * (I.dmax - I.d 1) :=
    mul_nonneg (I.af_nonneg 1) (by linarith [I.d_le_dmax 1])
  have t2 : 0 ≤ I.af 2 * (I.dmax - I.d 2) :=
    mul_nonneg (I.af_nonneg 2) (by linarith [I.d_le_dmax 2])
  have hD := I.dmax_pos
  nlinarith [I.af_mul_d 0, I.af_mul_d 1, I.af_mul_d 2, t0, t1, t2]

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.triple_blocked_af
statement:
theorem triple_blocked_af (h01 : I.Admissible {0, 1})
    (h12 : I.Admissible {1, 2}) (h : ¬ I.Admissible Finset.univ) :
    1 ≤ I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2
proof:
:=
  (I.triple_blocked_af_lt h01 h12 h).le

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.exists_admissible_weight
statement:
theorem exists_admissible_weight (m : Terminal → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i) :
    ∃ S : Finset Terminal, I.Admissible S ∧
      (∑ i, if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) ≤ rhoStar * ∑ i, m i * I.af i
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 := I.af_nonneg 0
  have ha1 := I.af_nonneg 1
  have ha2 := I.af_nonneg 2
  have hm0 := hm 0
  have hm1 := hm 1
  have hm2 := hm 2
  have hρ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ rhoStar := rhoStar_pos.le
  have hρ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ rhoStar := one_le_rhoStar
  have lift_pair : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → 1 ≤ rhoStar * s := fun s hs => by nlinarith
  have lift_sum : ∀ s : ℝ, 2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 ≤ s → 2 ≤ rhoStar * s := fun s hs => by
    have h2 := rhoStar_mul_denom
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hρ0]
  
  have eEmpty : (∑ i, if i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = 0 := by
    simp
  have e0 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 1 + m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e1 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({1} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 + m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e2 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 + m 1 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e01 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e02 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0, 2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 1 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e12 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  by_cases h01 : I.Admissible {0, 1} <;>
    by_cases h02 : I.Admissible {0, 2} <;>
    by_cases h12 : I.Admissible {1, 2}
  
  · by_cases huniv : I.Admissible Finset.univ
    · refine ⟨Finset.univ, huniv, ?_⟩
      rw [eEmpty, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm0 ha0, mul_nonneg hm1 ha1, mul_nonneg hm2 ha2]
    · 
      have hsum : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2) :=
        lift_pair _ (I.triple_blocked_af h01 h12 huniv)
      have core := weight_core_d hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2 hρ0 hsum
      rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with h01m | h01m
      · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with h02m | h02m
        · 
          rw [min_eq_left (le_min h01m h02m)] at core
          refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
          rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
        · 
          rw [min_eq_right (show m 2 ≤ m 1 by linarith),
            min_eq_right h02m] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
          rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
      · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with h12m | h12m
        · 
          rw [min_eq_left h12m, min_eq_right h01m] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
          rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
        · 
          rw [min_eq_right h12m,
            min_eq_right (show m 2 ≤ m 0 by linarith)] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
          rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af12 h12)
    have core := weight_core_c (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 1) (aj := I.af 0)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm1 hm0 hm2 ha1 ha0 ha2 hρ1 hik
    rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af02 h02)
    have core := weight_core_c (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 1)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2 hρ1 hik
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af02 h02)
    have hjk : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af12 h12)
    have core := weight_core_b (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 1)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2 hρ1 hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 0 + m 1) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
      rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af01 h01)
    have core := weight_core_c (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 1) hm0 hm2 hm1 ha0 ha2 ha1 hρ1 hik
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af01 h01)
    have hjk : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 2 + I.af 1) := by
      have h := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af12 h12)
      nlinarith [h]
    have core := weight_core_b (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 1) hm0 hm2 hm1 ha0 ha2 ha1 hρ1 hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 0 + m 2) (m 1) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
      rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have hik : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 1 + I.af 0) := by
      have h := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af01 h01)
      nlinarith [h]
    have hjk : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 2 + I.af 0) := by
      have h := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af02 h02)
      nlinarith [h]
    have core := weight_core_b (r := rhoStar) (ai := I.af 1) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 0) hm1 hm2 hm0 ha1 ha2 ha0 hρ1 hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 1 + m 2) (m 0) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
      rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [core]
  
  · have r01 : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af01 h01)
    have r02 : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af02 h02)
    have r12 : 1 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) := lift_pair _ (I.blocked_af12 h12)
    have rsum : 2 ≤ rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2) :=
      lift_sum _ (I.all_blocked_af h01 h12 h02)
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with hab | hab
    · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hbc | hbc
      · 
        have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 1) (a2 := I.af 0)
          (a3 := I.af 2) (m1 := m 1) (m2 := m 0) (m3 := m 2)
          hm0 hab hbc ha2 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r12]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
        refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
        rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [core]
      · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hac | hac
        · 
          have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 2) (a2 := I.af 0)
            (a3 := I.af 1) (m1 := m 2) (m2 := m 0) (m3 := m 1)
            hm0 hac hbc ha1 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r12]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
          refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
          rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
        · 
          have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 0) (a2 := I.af 2)
            (a3 := I.af 1) (m1 := m 0) (m2 := m 2) (m3 := m 1)
            hm2 hac hab ha1 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r01]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
          refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
          rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
    · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hac | hac
      · 
        have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 0) (a2 := I.af 1)
          (a3 := I.af 2) (m1 := m 0) (m2 := m 1) (m3 := m 2)
          hm1 hab hac ha2 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r02]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
        refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
        rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [core]
      · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hbc | hbc
        · 
          have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 2) (a2 := I.af 1)
            (a3 := I.af 0) (m1 := m 2) (m2 := m 1) (m3 := m 0)
            hm1 hbc hac ha0 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r02]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
          refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
          rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]
        · 
          have core := weight_core_a (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 1) (a2 := I.af 2)
            (a3 := I.af 0) (m1 := m 1) (m2 := m 2) (m3 := m 0)
            hm2 hbc hab ha0 hρ0 (by nlinarith [r01]) (by nlinarith [rsum])
          refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
          rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [core]

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.exists_admissible_weight_lt
statement:
theorem exists_admissible_weight_lt (m : Terminal → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, m i * I.af i) :
    ∃ S : Finset Terminal, I.Admissible S ∧
      (∑ i, if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) < rhoStar * ∑ i, m i * I.af i
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 := I.af_nonneg 0
  have ha1 := I.af_nonneg 1
  have ha2 := I.af_nonneg 2
  have hm0 := hm 0
  have hm1 := hm 1
  have hm2 := hm 2
  have hρ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ rhoStar := rhoStar_pos.le
  have hρ1 : (1 : ℝ) < rhoStar := one_lt_rhoStar
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hW
  have hWρ :
      m 0 * I.af 0 + m 1 * I.af 1 + m 2 * I.af 2 <
        rhoStar * (m 0 * I.af 0 + m 1 * I.af 1 + m 2 * I.af 2) := by
    have hp : 0 < (rhoStar - 1) *
        (m 0 * I.af 0 + m 1 * I.af 1 + m 2 * I.af 2) :=
      mul_pos (by linarith) hW
    nlinarith
  have lift_pair_lt : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → 1 < rhoStar * s := fun s hs => by
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr one_lt_rhoStar) hs0
    nlinarith
  have lift_sum_lt : ∀ s : ℝ, 2 * Real.sqrt 2 - 1 < s →
      2 < rhoStar * s := fun s hs => by
    have hp := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs rhoStar_pos
    nlinarith [rhoStar_mul_denom]
  have eUniv : (∑ i, if i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = 0 := by
    simp
  have e0 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 1 + m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e1 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({1} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 + m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e2 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 + m 1 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e01 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 2 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e02 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({0, 2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 1 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e12 : (∑ i, if i ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset Terminal) then 0 else m i) = m 0 := by
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  by_cases h01 : I.Admissible {0, 1} <;>
    by_cases h02 : I.Admissible {0, 2} <;>
    by_cases h12 : I.Admissible {1, 2}
  · by_cases huniv : I.Admissible Finset.univ
    · refine ⟨Finset.univ, huniv, ?_⟩
      rw [eUniv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      exact lt_trans (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) <
        m 0 * I.af 0 + m 1 * I.af 1 + m 2 * I.af 2) hWρ
    · have hsum : 1 ≤
          (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2) := by
        simpa using (I.triple_blocked_af_lt h01 h12 huniv).le
      have core := weight_core_d hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) hsum
      rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with h01m | h01m
      · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with h02m | h02m
        · rw [min_eq_left (le_min h01m h02m)] at core
          refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
          rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          norm_num at core
          linarith
        · rw [min_eq_right (show m 2 ≤ m 1 by linarith),
            min_eq_right h02m] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
          rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          norm_num at core
          linarith
      · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with h12m | h12m
        · rw [min_eq_left h12m, min_eq_right h01m] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
          rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          norm_num at core
          linarith
        · rw [min_eq_right h12m,
            min_eq_right (show m 2 ≤ m 0 by linarith)] at core
          refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
          rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          norm_num at core
          linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af12_lt h12).le
    have core := weight_core_c (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 1) (aj := I.af 0)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm1 hm0 hm2 ha1 ha0 ha2 (by norm_num) hik
    rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af02_lt h02).le
    have core := weight_core_c (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 1)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2 (by norm_num) hik
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af02_lt h02).le
    have hjk : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af12_lt h12).le
    have core := weight_core_b (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 1)
      (ak := I.af 2) hm0 hm1 hm2 ha0 ha1 ha2 (by norm_num) hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 0 + m 1) (m 2) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
      rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 1}, h01, ?_⟩
      rw [e01, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af01_lt h01).le
    have core := weight_core_c (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 1) hm0 hm2 hm1 ha0 ha2 ha1 (by norm_num) hik
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) := by
      simpa using (I.blocked_af01_lt h01).le
    have hjk : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 2 + I.af 1) := by
      have h := (I.blocked_af12_lt h12).le
      nlinarith
    have core := weight_core_b (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 0) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 1) hm0 hm2 hm1 ha0 ha2 ha1 (by norm_num) hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 0 + m 2) (m 1) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
      rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0, 2}, h02, ?_⟩
      rw [e02, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have hik : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 1 + I.af 0) := by
      have h := (I.blocked_af01_lt h01).le
      nlinarith
    have hjk : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (I.af 2 + I.af 0) := by
      have h := (I.blocked_af02_lt h02).le
      nlinarith
    have core := weight_core_b (r := (1 : ℝ)) (ai := I.af 1) (aj := I.af 2)
      (ak := I.af 0) hm1 hm2 hm0 ha1 ha2 ha0 (by norm_num) hik hjk
    rcases le_total (m 1 + m 2) (m 0) with hmin | hmin
    · rw [min_eq_left hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
      rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hmin] at core
      refine ⟨{1, 2}, h12, ?_⟩
      rw [e12, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      norm_num at core
      linarith
  · have r01 : 1 < rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1) :=
      lift_pair_lt _ (I.blocked_af01_lt h01)
    have r02 : 1 < rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 2) :=
      lift_pair_lt _ (I.blocked_af02_lt h02)
    have r12 : 1 < rhoStar * (I.af 1 + I.af 2) :=
      lift_pair_lt _ (I.blocked_af12_lt h12)
    have rsum : 2 < rhoStar * (I.af 0 + I.af 1 + I.af 2) :=
      lift_sum_lt _ (I.all_blocked_af_lt h01 h12 h02)
    rcases le_total (m 0) (m 1) with hab | hab
    · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hbc | hbc
      · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 1) (a2 := I.af 0)
          (a3 := I.af 2) (m1 := m 1) (m2 := m 0) (m3 := m 2)
          hm0 hab hbc ha2 hρ0 r12
          (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using rsum)
          (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hW)
        refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
        rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith
      · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hac | hac
        · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 2)
            (a2 := I.af 0) (a3 := I.af 1) (m1 := m 2) (m2 := m 0) (m3 := m 1)
            hm0 hac hbc ha1 hρ0
            (by simpa only [add_comm] using r12)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using rsum)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hW)
          refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
          rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith
        · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 0)
            (a2 := I.af 2) (a3 := I.af 1) (m1 := m 0) (m2 := m 2) (m3 := m 1)
            hm2 hac hab ha1 hρ0 r01
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using rsum)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hW)
          refine ⟨{1}, I.admissible_singleton 1, ?_⟩
          rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith
    · rcases le_total (m 0) (m 2) with hac | hac
      · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 0) (a2 := I.af 1)
          (a3 := I.af 2) (m1 := m 0) (m2 := m 1) (m3 := m 2)
          hm1 hab hac ha2 hρ0 r02 rsum hW
        refine ⟨{2}, I.admissible_singleton 2, ?_⟩
        rw [e2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith
      · rcases le_total (m 1) (m 2) with hbc | hbc
        · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 2)
            (a2 := I.af 1) (a3 := I.af 0) (m1 := m 2) (m2 := m 1) (m3 := m 0)
            hm1 hbc hac ha0 hρ0
            (by simpa only [add_comm] using r02)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using rsum)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hW)
          refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
          rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith
        · have core := weight_core_a_lt (r := rhoStar) (a1 := I.af 1)
            (a2 := I.af 2) (a3 := I.af 0) (m1 := m 1) (m2 := m 2) (m3 := m 0)
            hm2 hbc hab ha0 hρ0
            (by simpa only [add_comm] using r01)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using rsum)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hW)
          refine ⟨{0}, I.admissible_singleton 0, ?_⟩
          rw [e0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.fcost_af
statement:
theorem fcost_af :
    I.fcost = I.base +
      (I.af 0 * I.sav 0 + I.af 1 * I.sav 1 + I.af 2 * I.sav 2)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, I.af i * I.sav i = (I.d i - I.f i) * (I.WE i - I.WZ i) := by
    intro i
    have hd := (I.d_pos i).ne'
    rw [af, sav]
    field_simp
  rw [fcost_eq_base, Fin.sum_univ_three, ← key 0, ← key 1, ← key 2]

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.exists_admissible_ucost_le
statement:
theorem exists_admissible_ucost_le :
    ∃ S : Finset Terminal, I.Admissible S ∧ I.ucost S ≤ rhoStar * I.fcost
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m : Terminal → ℝ := fun i => max (I.sav i) 0 with hm_def
  have hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i := fun i => le_max_right _ _
  obtain ⟨S, hSadm, hSw⟩ := I.exists_admissible_weight m hm
  set S' : Finset Terminal := S.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ I.sav i) with hS'_def
  have hS'sub : S' ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  refine ⟨S', I.admissible_mono hS'sub hSadm, ?_⟩
  have hρ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ rhoStar := one_le_rhoStar
  
  have hP : ∀ i : Terminal, (if i ∈ S' then 0 else I.sav i) ≤
      (if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + (rhoStar - 1) * (I.d i * I.WZ i) +
        rhoStar * (I.af i * min (I.sav i) 0) := by
    intro i
    have hdWZ : 0 ≤ I.d i * I.WZ i := mul_nonneg (I.d_pos i).le (I.WZ_nonneg i)
    have hsavlow := I.sav_lower i
    have haf0 := I.af_nonneg i
    have haf1 := I.af_le_one i
    by_cases hiS' : i ∈ S'
    · have hiS : i ∈ S := hS'sub hiS'
      have hsav0 : 0 ≤ I.sav i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiS').2
      simp only [hiS', hiS, ite_true]
      rw [min_eq_right hsav0]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ rhoStar - 1) hdWZ]
    · simp only [hiS', ite_false]
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · have hsavneg : I.sav i < 0 :=
          lt_of_not_ge fun hpos => hiS' (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hiS, hpos⟩)
        simp only [hiS, ite_true]
        rw [min_eq_left hsavneg.le]
        rcases le_total (rhoStar * I.af i) 1 with hra | hra
        · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hra) (neg_nonneg.2 hsavneg.le),
            mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ rhoStar - 1) hdWZ]
        · have t1 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i + I.sav i) * (rhoStar * I.af i - 1) :=
            mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
          have t2 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i) * (rhoStar * (1 - I.af i)) :=
            mul_nonneg hdWZ (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
          nlinarith [t1, t2]
      · simp only [hiS, ite_false]
        rcases le_total 0 (I.sav i) with hsav | hsav
        · have hmi : m i = I.sav i := max_eq_left hsav
          rw [min_eq_right hsav, hmi]
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ rhoStar - 1) hdWZ]
        · have hmi : m i = 0 := max_eq_right hsav
          rw [min_eq_left hsav, hmi]
          rcases le_total (rhoStar * I.af i) 1 with hra | hra
          · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hra) (neg_nonneg.2 hsav),
              mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ rhoStar - 1) hdWZ]
          · have t1 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i + I.sav i) * (rhoStar * I.af i - 1) :=
              mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
            have t2 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i) * (rhoStar * (1 - I.af i)) :=
              mul_nonneg hdWZ (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
            nlinarith [t1, t2]
  
  have hid' : ∀ i : Terminal, rhoStar * (I.af i * I.sav i) =
      rhoStar * (I.af i * m i) + rhoStar * (I.af i * min (I.sav i) 0) := by
    intro i
    have hsum : m i + min (I.sav i) 0 = I.sav i := by
      rw [hm_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [max_add_min, add_zero]
    linear_combination (-(rhoStar * I.af i)) * hsum
  have hbase : I.base = I.d 0 * I.WZ 0 + I.d 1 * I.WZ 1 + I.d 2 * I.WZ 2 := by
    rw [base, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hbase' : rhoStar * I.base =
      rhoStar * (I.d 0 * I.WZ 0) + rhoStar * (I.d 1 * I.WZ 1) +
        rhoStar * (I.d 2 * I.WZ 2) := by
    rw [hbase]
    ring
  rw [ucost_eq_base, Fin.sum_univ_three, fcost_af]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hSw
  linarith [hP 0, hP 1, hP 2, hSw, hid' 0, hid' 1, hid' 2, hbase, hbase']

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.base_negative_savings_le
statement:
theorem base_negative_savings_le :
    I.base + ∑ i, min (I.sav i) 0 ≤
      rhoStar * (I.base + ∑ i, I.af i * min (I.sav i) 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ rhoStar := one_le_rhoStar
  have hq : ∀ i : Terminal,
      min (I.sav i) 0 ≤
        (rhoStar - 1) * (I.d i * I.WZ i) +
          rhoStar * (I.af i * min (I.sav i) 0) := by
    intro i
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ I.d i * I.WZ i :=
      mul_nonneg (I.d_pos i).le (I.WZ_nonneg i)
    have hn0 : min (I.sav i) 0 ≤ 0 := min_le_right _ _
    have hnlower : -(I.d i * I.WZ i) ≤ min (I.sav i) 0 :=
      le_min (I.sav_lower i) (neg_nonpos.mpr hb0)
    have ha0 := I.af_nonneg i
    have ha1 := I.af_le_one i
    rcases le_total (rhoStar * I.af i) 1 with hra | hra
    · have t1 : 0 ≤ (1 - rhoStar * I.af i) * (-min (I.sav i) 0) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) (neg_nonneg.mpr hn0)
      have t2 : 0 ≤ (rhoStar - 1) * (I.d i * I.WZ i) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) hb0
      nlinarith
    · have t1 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i + min (I.sav i) 0) *
          (rhoStar * I.af i - 1) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have t2 : 0 ≤ (I.d i * I.WZ i) * (rhoStar * (1 - I.af i)) :=
        mul_nonneg hb0 (mul_nonneg rhoStar_pos.le (by linarith))
      nlinarith
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hq i
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hsum
  rw [base]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring_nf at hsum ⊢
  linarith

name: Goemans.FlowInstance.exists_admissible_ucost_lt
statement:
theorem exists_admissible_ucost_lt (hfc : 0 < I.fcost) :
    ∃ S : Finset Terminal, I.Admissible S ∧ I.ucost S < rhoStar * I.fcost
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m : Terminal → ℝ := fun i => max (I.sav i) 0 with hm_def
  set n : Terminal → ℝ := fun i => min (I.sav i) 0 with hn_def
  have hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i := fun i => le_max_right _ _
  have hn : ∀ i, n i ≤ 0 := fun i => by
    rw [hn_def]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  have hsav : ∀ i, I.sav i = m i + n i := by
    intro i
    rw [hm_def, hn_def, max_add_min, add_zero]
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, m i * I.af i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hm i) (I.af_nonneg i)
  have hfdec : I.fcost =
      I.base + (∑ i, m i * I.af i) + (∑ i, I.af i * n i) := by
    rw [fcost_af]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsav 0, hsav 1, hsav 2]
    ring
  have hNV : (∑ i, n i) ≤ ∑ i, I.af i * n i := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have t : (1 - I.af i) * n i ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr (I.af_le_one i)) (hn i)
    nlinarith
  by_cases hW : (∑ i, m i * I.af i) = 0
  · obtain ⟨S, hSadm, hSw⟩ := I.exists_admissible_weight m hm
    set S' : Finset Terminal := S.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ I.sav i) with hS'_def
    have hS'sub : S' ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    refine ⟨S', I.admissible_mono hS'sub hSadm, ?_⟩
    have hid : ∀ i : Terminal,
        (if i ∈ S' then 0 else I.sav i) =
          (if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + n i := by
      intro i
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · by_cases hs : 0 ≤ I.sav i
        · simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hn_def]
        · have hs' : I.sav i ≤ 0 := (lt_of_not_ge hs).le
          simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hn_def, hs']
      · by_cases hs : 0 ≤ I.sav i
        · simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hm_def, hn_def]
        · have hs' : I.sav i ≤ 0 := (lt_of_not_ge hs).le
          simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hm_def, hn_def, hs']
    have hsumid :
        (∑ i, if i ∈ S' then 0 else I.sav i) =
          (∑ i, if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + ∑ i, n i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hid i
    have hfcρ : I.fcost < rhoStar * I.fcost := by
      have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr one_lt_rhoStar) hfc
      nlinarith
    rw [hW, mul_zero] at hSw
    rw [ucost_eq_base, hsumid]
    nlinarith [hSw, hNV, hfdec, hfcρ]
  · have hWpos : 0 < ∑ i, m i * I.af i := lt_of_le_of_ne hW0 (Ne.symm hW)
    obtain ⟨S, hSadm, hSw⟩ := I.exists_admissible_weight_lt m hm hWpos
    set S' : Finset Terminal := S.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ I.sav i) with hS'_def
    have hS'sub : S' ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    refine ⟨S', I.admissible_mono hS'sub hSadm, ?_⟩
    have hid : ∀ i : Terminal,
        (if i ∈ S' then 0 else I.sav i) =
          (if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + n i := by
      intro i
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · by_cases hs : 0 ≤ I.sav i
        · simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hn_def]
        · have hs' : I.sav i ≤ 0 := (lt_of_not_ge hs).le
          simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hn_def, hs']
      · by_cases hs : 0 ≤ I.sav i
        · simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hm_def, hn_def]
        · have hs' : I.sav i ≤ 0 := (lt_of_not_ge hs).le
          simp [hS'_def, hiS, hs, hm_def, hn_def, hs']
    have hsumid :
        (∑ i, if i ∈ S' then 0 else I.sav i) =
          (∑ i, if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + ∑ i, n i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hid i
    have hneg : I.base + ∑ i, n i ≤
        rhoStar * (I.base + ∑ i, I.af i * n i) := by
      simpa [hn_def] using I.base_negative_savings_le
    rw [ucost_eq_base, hsumid]
    calc
      I.base + ((∑ i, if i ∈ S then 0 else m i) + ∑ i, n i) <
          rhoStar * (∑ i, m i * I.af i) +
            rhoStar * (I.base + ∑ i, I.af i * n i) := by
              linarith
      _ = rhoStar * I.fcost := by rw [hfdec]; ring

name: Goemans.graphRatios_eq_hStarRatios
statement: theorem graphRatios_eq_hStarRatios : graphRatios = hStarRatios
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨J, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨J.1.toFlowInstance, by simpa using J.2⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [PositiveCostInstance.ratio, PositiveGraphInstance.ratio]
  · rintro ⟨I, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨I.1.toGraph, by simpa using I.2⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [PositiveCostInstance.ratio, PositiveGraphInstance.ratio]

name: Goemans.graphRatios_isLUB
statement: theorem graphRatios_isLUB : IsLUB graphRatios rhoStar
proof:
:=
  graphRatios_eq_hStarRatios ▸ hStarRatios_isLUB

name: Goemans.PositiveGraphInstance.ratio_lt_rhoStar
statement:
theorem PositiveGraphInstance.ratio_lt_rhoStar (J : PositiveGraphInstance) :
    J.ratio < rhoStar
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : J.ratio ∈ graphRatios := ⟨J, rfl⟩
  rw [graphRatios_eq_hStarRatios] at hJ
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := hJ
  rw [← hI]
  exact I.ratio_lt_rhoStar

name: Goemans.theoremA_graph
statement: theorem theoremA_graph : sSup graphRatios = rhoStar ∧ rhoStar ∉ graphRatios
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphRatios_eq_hStarRatios]
  exact ⟨rhoHStar_eq_rhoStar, rhoStar_not_mem_hStarRatios⟩

name: Goemans.theoremA_graph_strict
statement:
theorem theoremA_graph_strict :
    IsLUB graphRatios rhoStar ∧
      ∀ J : PositiveGraphInstance, J.ratio < rhoStar
proof:
:=
  ⟨graphRatios_isLUB, PositiveGraphInstance.ratio_lt_rhoStar⟩
